fdroid:app.weave.description:
Weave is a decentralized social app built around customizable profiles, group discussions, and user choice in moderation.
Instead of relying on a conventional centralized social-media server, Weave runs an embedded VeilKnit node over the Veilid network.
Features include:
• Custom profile pages with backgrounds, foreground elements, text, images, audio, links, and widgets.
• Search and discovery for people and shared content.
• Groups with posts, comments, media, and Snapshot views of active conversations.
• Moderation branches so users can choose which moderation view to follow, with support for moderation claiming and continuity.
• Local on-device content filtering for supported image and text categories.
• Sandboxed widgets that are loaded on demand and compiled locally from visible source.
• No direct-message system; social interaction is centered on visible profiles, groups, posts, and comments.
Weave is under active development, so some areas may still be rough around the edges while the decentralized networking and moderation systems continue to mature.

fdroid:com.aipos.aipospm.name: AIPOS Password Manager

fdroid:com.aipos.aipospm.description:
AIPOS Password Manager is a premium, fully offline, and highly secure Android application for storing passwords, API keys, and 2FA secrets. Designed with modern Material You guidelines, hardware-backed cryptography via Android Keystore, and a local-first architecture.
Key Features:
* Dual Vault Support: Seamlessly manage credentials (passwords, usernames, URLs) and API keys with a tailored developer experience.
* Premium Design System: Visual identity featuring a trust-centric palette (teal-blue, soft indigo, warm amber) and native Material You dynamic styling on Android 12+.
* Animated Vault Health Dashboard: Central dashboard featuring an animated health score circle, staggered entrance animations, and quick actions.
* Hardened Security:
 - AES-256-GCM encryption with hardware-backed keys inside the Android Keystore.
 - PBKDF2 with HmacSHA256 (120,000 iterations) for master password verification.
 - EncryptedSharedPreferences to safely cache user authentication metadata.
 - Native Biometric Prompt support.
* Portable Encrypted Backups: Export and import your local database to an encrypted JSON backup file using a password derived via PBKDF2 (100,000 iterations) + AES-256-GCM.
* Offline Breach Check: Real-time evaluation of master passwords and entry credentials against a bundled database of common weak passwords—without making a single network request.
* Built-in 2FA Authenticator (TOTP): Scan QR codes directly offline using the built-in CameraX scanner and generate time-based one-time passwords directly within the app.
* Auto-Lock Timeout: Configurable inactivity timers (Immediately, 1 min, 5 min, 10 min, Never) to keep your vault secure when backgrounded.
* 100% Offline & Private: Zero network permissions declared. Your data never leaves your device.
* Third-Party CSV Importers: Import credentials from Bitwarden, KeePass, and 1Password CSV exports.

fdroid:com.vonglasow.michael.qz.name: Qz
fdroid:com.vonglasow.michael.qz.summary: Receive live traffic news via Traffic Message Channel (TMC)
fdroid:com.vonglasow.michael.qz.description:
Receive live traffic news via Traffic Message Channel (TMC)
Qz (pronounced “queues”) connects to an RDS/TMC receiver to receive live traffic messages. TMC is transmitted in the RDS data stream of various radio channels and provides live traffic information, helping you avoid congestions.
For a list of countries in which this app can be used, see https://gitlab.com/mvglasow/qz/wikis/countries.
In order to use this app, you will need a supported RDS/TMC receiver. The following devices are currently supported:
* GNS FM9-BT (requires Bluetooth)
* Silicon Labs Si4701/4703-based USB tuners (requires USB OTG support)
If you are unable to pick up any traffic messages, despite having a supported device and being in an area which should be supported, check your antenna. Reception with pigtail antennas (a long piece of wire coming out of the receiver) is generally poor and insufficient for TMC. It is recommended to rely on your vehicle antenna, a building antenna or a somewhat decent room antenna.
Qz will only work with unencrypted TMC services (as encrypted services require paying a per-device royalty). Also, some countries have chosen to require paying a royalty for access to their location tables (which Qz needs to decode TMC locations) and are therefore not supported.
Photo by Joanna Pędzich-Opioła | CC_BY 2.0

fdroid:dev.kaleve.nonius.name: Nonius
fdroid:dev.kaleve.nonius.summary: Ten measuring instruments. No ads, no trackers, no network.
fdroid:dev.kaleve.nonius.description:
Your phone has a gravity sensor, a magnetometer, a barometer, a light sensor and a microphone. Android gives you none of them. The apps that fill the gap are mostly a banner ad with a bubble drawn on top.
Nonius is the other kind. Every face is drawn as an instrument rather than assembled from stock components, and every reading that depends on hardware has a calibration you can set, because no sensor is perfect and no screen reports its own size honestly.
 The instruments 
• Level , a round vial and a tube at once, with a zero point stored for your device, in degrees, percent or millimetres per metre
• Compass , heading and field strength, true north from a declination you set since there is no location permission to find it for you, and the same face doubles as a metal detector for finding a nail behind plaster
• Ruler , millimetres and inches, calibrated against a bank card rather than against the pixel density the panel claims
• Sound level , in dB(A) or dB(Z), with peak and minimum hold, asking the device for the unprocessed microphone so that gain control cannot rewrite the number
• Tuner , note and cents by YIN pitch detection, concert pitch adjustable from 415 to 466 Hz
• Counter , a tally you tap anywhere or raise with the volume keys, which survives closing the app
• Altimeter , height above a mark you set, exact enough to measure a staircase, with the pressure trend
• Light meter , lux across six decades, from moonlight to direct sun
• Metronome , BPM 30 to 250 and beats per bar 1 to 12 with the first beat accented, sample-accurate clicks
• G-force , the magnitude of the three accelerometer axes against standard gravity, with peak hold
Instruments your device has no sensor for are shown greyed out with the reason, instead of opening and then apologising.
 What it does not do 
There is no INTERNET permission in the manifest, so the app cannot send anything anywhere even by accident. The single permission is the microphone, requested when you open the sound level meter or the tuner. Nothing is recorded: each frame of audio becomes one number and is discarded. The only thing stored is the handful of calibration values for your device.
Free software, GPL-3.0-or-later.

fdroid:dev.leeeet.wallpapermoe.name: Wallpaper Moe
fdroid:dev.leeeet.wallpapermoe.summary: Changes your wallpaper from online collections, a folder or your favorites
fdroid:dev.leeeet.wallpapermoe.description:
Wallpaper Moe is a live wallpaper that changes itself. It gets wallpapers from online collections, from a folder on your device, or from your favorites. A change occurs when the screen goes off: each time, or at most each hour, each 6 hours or each day.
Features
- Home and lock screen: both screens can use one source, or each screen can have its own source and frequency. Each screen has its own brightness, contrast and blur.
- Sources that you build: a source can use other sources, so you configure a source one time.
- History and favorites: the last 20 wallpapers stay on the device at full size. You can put favorites in order.
- Viewer: swipe and zoom, set as wallpaper, save to the gallery, share, or open the source page.
- Next wallpaper tile in Quick Settings.
- Wallpaper colors for the system theme.
- Automatic changes can wait for an unmetered network.
- Backup and restore of sources, settings and favorites.
Sources
- Wallhaven searches wallhaven.cc by text, category, purity, aspect ratio and order.
- Nekos.best gets anime artwork from the kinds that you select.
- Pandora gets images from Xiaomi's public wallpaper channels.
- Device folder uses the images in a folder on your device.
- Favorites uses the wallpapers that you marked with a heart, at random or in your order.
- Keep ready prepares wallpapers before a change, saves wallpapers for later, or both.
- Combine uses two or more sources at random, in turn, or as fallbacks.
Privacy
Wallpaper Moe has no ads, no analytics and no tracking. All data stays on the device. The app connects only to the providers of the sources that you configure. Pandora requests contain the app version, the language, the screen width, the time and a random identifier for this installation. The app sends your Wallhaven API key only for searches that include NSFW images.
Wallpaper Moe requires Android 14 or newer. It has no connection with wallhaven.cc, Nekos.best or Xiaomi, and they do not endorse it. The terms of the creators and providers apply to the wallpaper images.

flathub:page.codeberg.DrRac27.Karoto.name: Karoto Shopping List
flathub:page.codeberg.DrRac27.Karoto.summary: A shopping list app for Linux mobile
flathub:page.codeberg.DrRac27.Karoto.description:
A Linux mobile app that helps you with your groceries. It is not just a fancy replacement for your notes app but instead works a bit like a stock management software. The heart of the app is a list with things you always want to have at home. Before you go to the grocery store or whereever you get your stuff from you can go through this list and check for every item how much you have in your storage. The app then generates the shopping list for you which makes it impossible to forget anything.
 Additional features:
 only once: If you need something like a new knive or some new plates e.g. there is the "only once" option where the item automatically gets deleted as soon as you got it once.
 tags: You can add tags to your items and filter for them. One example workflow could be to tag everything thats in the fridge with a tag called "Fridge" and when you check whats missing you filter for fridge stuff and only open the fridge once. The same can be done while shopping: Tag items for where you can get them and click on the tag when you are there.
 hide temporary: Imagine you have a long shopping list but not enough money with you or some items would be to heavy/big to carry so you decide to get it next time. Now you can click on the Hide temporary button and the item disappears until you restart the app so it does not annoy you.

flathub:uk.co.studiopond.spiderbro2.name: Spiderbro 2
flathub:uk.co.studiopond.spiderbro2.description:
Spiderbro 2 is a retro inspired adventure puzzle game for Windows and Linux. You play as Shadowbro, a spider that has to save the multiverse from the antics of a real life computer worm!
 EXPLORE, COLLECT ITEMS, SOLVE PUZZLES! Make your way deeper into the company building by exploring the environment and collecting items for your pockets! Use your pocket items on world objects, give them to NPCs or merge them with one another to solve puzzles!
 THE IN-GAME PCs ARE BACK WITH AN UPGRADE! Use the in-game PCs and check for further clues! Text logs with clues and backstory can be found on PCs found throughout the game! Take a trip to PC-SPACE, a company exclusive VR service that takes using a PC to new depths!
 A WORM IS LOOSE! THE MULTIVERSE IS COLLIDING! A computer worm gone wild has broken into the real world! More cracks and holes to new universes have appeared! In Spiderbro 2 you should expect the unexpected as you overcome the worm whilst travelling between different universes!
 DISCOVER COMPANY SECRETS! Go deeper into the company building and find out what triggered the events of Spiderbro! Each new department will unravel more secrets!
 NO NEED TO PLAY THE PREQUEL! Players need not play the first Spiderbro! Spiderbro 2 expands upon the first game in a way that does not require the player to complete it! Spiderbro 2 also contains a copy of the first game, within the game!
 YOU WILL DIE! Be warned that this world is not safe! Make frequent use of savepoints to prevent losing progress!
 EVEN MORE!
 34 In-game Awards
 New game plus mode
 Two possible conclusions
 Built in Cheat Sheet with all puzzle solutions
 CONTROLS
 Arrow Keys / WASD - Movement
 SPACE / ENTER - Interact
 P / E - Open Pockets
 ESC - Back / Pause

fedora-packages:aftertheflood-sparks-fon.description: After the Flood Sparks is a font that allows for the combination of text and visual data to show an idea and evidence in one headline. This builds on the principle of Sparklines defined by Edward Tufte and makes them easier to use. Sparklines are currently available as plugins or javascript elements. By installing the Sparks font you can use them immediately without the need for custom code. Sparks data needs to be formatted as comma-separated values, with curly brackets at both ends of the set, e.g., {30,60,90}. You can also have numbers at the beginning and end of the set, which are useful for providing the start and end points, e.g., 123{30,60,90}456 – Sparks has numerals built in. fedora-packages:gloo/gloo.name: gloo
fedora-packages:gloo/gloo.description: Gloo is a collective communications library. It comes with a number of collective algorithms useful for machine learning applications. These include a barrier, broadcast, and allreduce. Transport of data between participating machines is abstracted so that IP can be used at all times, or InifiniBand (or RoCE) when available. In the latter case, if the InfiniBand transport is used, GPUDirect can be used to accelerate cross machine GPU-to-GPU memory transfers. Where applicable, algorithms have an implementation that works with system memory buffers, and one that works with NVIDIA GPU memory buffers. In the latter case, it is not necessary to copy memory between host and device; this is taken care of by the algorithm implementations.

Judy's key benefits are scalability, high performance, and memory efficiency. A Judy array is extensible and can scale up to a very large number of elements, bounded only by machine memory. Since Judy is designed as an unbounded array, the size of a Judy array is not pre-allocated but grows and shrinks dynamically with the array population. This package adds a modified SL library that accepts fixed length byte arrays.

fedora-packages:lasi/lasi.description: LASi is a library written by Larry Siden that provides a C++ stream output interface ( with operator << ) for creating Postscript documents that can contain characters from any of the scripts and symbol blocks supported in Unicode and by Owen Taylor's Pango layout engine. The library accommodates right-to-left scripts such as Arabic and Hebrew as easily as left-to-right scripts. Indic and Indic-derived Complex Text Layout (CTL) scripts, such as Devanagari, Thai, Lao, and Tibetan are supported to the extent provided by Pango and by the OpenType fonts installed on your system. Although the capability to produce Unicode-based multilingual Postscript documents exists in large Open Source application framework libraries such as GTK+, QT, and KDE, LASi was designed for projects which require the ability to produce Postscript independent of any one application framework.

firefox-addons:997624.name: re:consent – enhanced privacy control
firefox-addons:997624.summary: This add-on shows you which data collection purposes you have (unwittingly) agreed to on websites such as Google or Facebook. You can then change these settings quickly and easily.
firefox-addons:997624.description:
The add-on aims to provide better transparency into which data websites collect and process when you visit them. It leads you directly to the often well-hidden privacy settings so you can quickly and easily check and change your consent for data processing, e.g. location sharing, face recognition or cookie tracking.
re:consent currently only works for websites that adhere to the “Transparency & Consent Framework” of the Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB), as well as Google and Facebook. For other websites it remains hidden. The free transparency tool is integrated into the Cliqz Browser for Windows and Mac and is available as an extension for Chrome and Firefox.
re:consent offers enhanced control over which data you share directly with website owners. It’s a smart addition to third-party tracking protection tools provided by Cliqz and Ghostery. 
re:consent is an open source software created by Munich based Cliqz GmbH owned by Mozilla and Hubert Burda Media. 
For more information, please visit https://cliqz.com/magazine/re-consent

firefox-addons:2988462.name: CleanLink Privacy & Tracker Blocker
firefox-addons:2988462.summary: Automatically removes tracking parameters from links and URLs, including utm_*, fbclid, gclid, msclkid, ttclid, and 50+ others, so you can browse, copy, and share cleaner links with better privacy.
firefox-addons:2988462.description:
CleanLink automatically removes tracking parameters from URLs before pages load, so links stay cleaner, shorter, and more private.
It strips common trackers such as utm_* , fbclid , gclid , msclkid , ttclid , twclid , mkt_tok , mc_cid , and many others.
 Main features 
- Automatically cleans tracking parameters from links during browsing
- Cleans links directly on the page before you click them
- Cleans copied links so shared URLs stay private and readable
- Works quietly in the background with no setup required
- Includes an optional anonymous analytics mode that can be turned off at any time
 Why it matters 
Advertising and analytics platforms use tagged URLs to track where traffic comes from and to help build behavioral profiles. CleanLink removes those parameters before they spread through your browsing, bookmarks, clipboard, and shared links.
 Anonymous analytics 
If enabled, CleanLink sends only limited anonymized technical and usage data:
- visited domain
- event date and time
- country code
- random install ID
- browser language
- basic browser metadata
 What CleanLink does not collect 
- names
- email addresses
- passwords
- form contents
- cookies
- messages
- page contents
- precise location
 Data use 
Anonymous data is used only for:
- debugging extension behavior
- improving tracker detection
- understanding which trackers appear most often
- measuring which websites use tracking parameters most heavily
 We never sell user data. 
Read more in the built-in Privacy Policy .

firefox-addons:2980146.name: Privatiser
firefox-addons:2980146.summary: Anonymize sensitive data before pasting into AI chats. Redacts IPs, API keys, passwords, PII, and cloud identifiers. Auto-restores originals when you copy the AI response. 100% local — nothing leaves your browser.
firefox-addons:2980146.description:
Privatiser automatically anonymizes sensitive content when you paste into AI chat sites like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Copilot.
HOW IT WORKS:
• Paste into any supported AI chat — sensitive data is automatically replaced with consistent pseudonyms
• The AI can still understand and help with your text because the structure is preserved
• Copy the AI's response — original values are automatically restored to your clipboard
WHAT IT DETECTS:
• Secrets: API keys (AWS, OpenAI, GitHub, Slack), JWTs, bearer tokens, PEM keys, connection strings, SSH keys
• Network: IPv4 addresses, domain names, email addresses, MAC addresses, internal URLs
• PII: Phone numbers (US/UK), credit cards (Luhn-validated), Social Security numbers, passport numbers, IBANs
• Cloud: AWS account IDs, ARNs, S3 buckets, Azure subscription IDs, GCP project IDs
• Identifiers: UUIDs
FEATURES:
• Auto-anonymize on paste into AI chat sites
• Auto-restore originals when copying AI responses
• Right-click context menu for manual anonymize/deanonymize
• Toggle pattern categories on/off (Secrets, Network, PII, AWS, Cloud, Identifiers)
• Allowlist specific values to skip
• Built-in anonymize/deanonymize tool in the popup
• Mapping table to see what was replaced
PRIVACY:
• 100% local processing — no data is sent anywhere
• No analytics, no telemetry, no external requests
• Mappings stay in your browser session only
SUPPORTED SITES:
• ChatGPT ( chat.openai.com , chatgpt.com )
• Claude ( claude.ai )
• Gemini ( gemini.google.com )
• Copilot ( copilot.microsoft.com )
Website: https://privatiser.net

firefox-addons:2935537.name: security.txt file detector
firefox-addons:2935537.summary: Check if a website provides a security.txt file.
firefox-addons:2935537.description:
The extension aims at helping ethical hackers to check easily and quickly if a website publishes a security.txt file (cf. RFC 9116 A File Format to Aid in Security Vulnerability Disclosure).
It does so by:
- showing a red (no such file) or green icon (file present);
- displaying its content.
Caveat: When a [root directory]/.well-known/security.txt file exists, its content is displayed without any syntax check.
Note to people intending to get in touch with me to “help my extension grow”, “drive growth for Firefox extensions”,...: don't waste your time, I definitely do not want to waste mine. This extension is, and will remain FREE.

firefox-addons:549252.name: AdBlocker Lite
firefox-addons:549252.summary: block ads seamlessly on popular websites
firefox-addons:549252.description:
AdBlocker Lite is a browser add-on that enables you to block annoying ads seamlessly on popular websites. It has 2 modes, Lite and Full. In lite mode, the extension uses the least amount of CPU power and memory and it runs based on pure CSS. Lite mode is ideal for slow machines. In full mode, more ads are targeted and more CPU power and memory are required.
Some important features:
1. It allows you to block annoying ads, scripts, images, iframes and many more.
2. Ultra-lite extension with no significant memory and CPU usage.
3. Unlike other similar products, AdBlocker Lite uses hard coded filtering rules for fast and reliable performance.
4. Provides an easy access filtering list if you wish to allow advertisement on some websites.
5. Includes ON|OFF button to quickly disable or enable the extension.
6. Includes Highlight/Block modes; in highlight mode, you can only highlight ads without blocking (hiding) them, but in block mode, ads are blocked.
7. Easily switch between full and lite modes (default is lite mode).
8. Add custom blocking rules. Currently, only rules in the form of css-selectors are accepted.
9. Badge icon text shows the number of blocked ads (active in full mode only).
Note 1: In AdBlocker Lite you can allow some websites (including its homepage) to show non-intrusive advertisements. By doing this you support websites that rely on advertising. Some websites are added by default, but this list can be modified at any time.
Note 2: AdBlocker Lite is designed to block ads on popular websites only (i.e. facebook, youtube, gmail, yahoo mail, etc). Besides, it does not block popup-ads, if you need a full-featured adblocker please use other adblocker addons in the addon store.
Note 3: To add a custom rule, please use css-selectors. For example, the following rule hides a div element with class test: div[class='test']. Please note, you can only add valid CSS rules, otherwise, it won't be added to the list.

firefox-addons:814814.name: Stylus
firefox-addons:814814.summary: Redesign your favorite websites with Stylus, an actively developed and community driven userstyles manager. Easily install custom themes from popular online repositories, or create, edit, and manage your own personalized CSS stylesheets.
firefox-addons:814814.description:
Redesign your favorite websites with Stylus, an actively developed and community driven userstyles manager. Easily install custom themes from popular online repositories, or create, edit, and manage your own personalized CSS stylesheets. Features
  • Versatility of theme installation options. Stylus supports installs from popular online repositories. Additionally, styles can now also be installed from .user.css or .user.styl URLs (see Usercss format documentation in our github wiki).
  • A backup feature for your entire database of installed styles which is compatible with other userstyles managers.
  • An intuitive and configurable automatic update function for installed styles.
  • A highly customizable UI, including theming, optional layouts, icon and badge color choices, along with many other tweaks.
  • Two different optional code validators with user configurable rules.
Useful Links
  • Source code: https://github.com/openstyles/stylus
  • Video tutorial: https://youtu.be/fCVvGwoF5cQ
  • Chat room: https://discord.gg/tzXVNJz
  • Frequently asked questions: https://github.com/openstyles/stylus/wiki/FAQ
  • Technical bug report: https://github.com/openstyles/stylus/issues
  • General discussion and bug report: https://add0n.com/stylus.html#reviews
  • Localization: https://www.transifex.com/github-7/Stylus/dashboard/
Permissions Stylus uses only a small subset of each permission. As you can see in WebExtensions API documentation or simplified tutorials, there's no way to apply any modifications to a web page without gaining the full access permission to that page. Stylus is mostly used to apply global themes, which is why it requests a global permission. In the future we might be able to implement a more granular approach but it's not exactly trivial.
  • Access your data for all websites - required for the style elements to be added into the page, not to access any of your data.
  • Access browser tabs - required to show styles in the popup, and for some auxiliary features like regexp tester in the editor.
  • Access browser activity during navigation - required to insert the styles at the exact moment the page is navigated to a different URL.
  • Identity - required for access to cloud services to allow importing and exporting of styles (e.g. Dropbox, etc).
Privacy Policy Unlike other similar extensions, we don't find you to be all that interesting. Your questionable browsing history should remain between you and the NSA. Stylus collects nothing. Period. Firefox related notes
  • To import styles from Stylish add-on please read https://github.com/openstyles/stylus/wiki/FAQ#how-can-i-export-my-user-styles-from-stylish-for-firefox-to-stylus
  • Stylus doesn't apply userstyles to the browser UI or the built-in pages like about:addons because there's no WebExtension API for dynamic application of CSS. You may use another extension that runs an externally installed companion utility to modify userChrome.css and userContent.css and restart Firefox. This restriction is imposed intentionally by Mozilla for security purposes. We don't plan to incorporate the above-mentioned workaround. See https://github.com/openstyles/stylus/wiki/Styling-Firefox-UI
  • Export backups of your database frequently. The main reason we've kept the "beta" status for so long is because WebExtension support is still a work in progress for Firefox. Many Firefox specific workarounds have been implemented, but backing up your DB regularly will save you a lot of aggravation should something happen to go wrong.

Scan Translator is a manga translator Chrome extension for raw manga, manhwa, webtoons, scans, screenshots and image-based text.

firefox-addons:2826122.name: Dual Subtitles & Translator Extension - InterSub
firefox-addons:2826122.summary: Use dual subtitles for language learning with Netflix, YouTube, Crunchyroll and online courses. Translator extension with pop-up dictionary: hover any word, translate meaning, save it into your vocabulary builder and learn new words.
firefox-addons:2826122.description:
InterSub turns the shows and courses you already watch into language lessons. Use dual subtitles to see the original line and its translation together, and a translator extension that explains any word you hover, in videos and on websites.
💡 What's new
• Telegram bot for practising your saved words: t.me/InterSubWords_bot?start=ff_as 
• Auto-hide subtitles on YouTube.
• Forced AI translation of the second subtitle line, based on the original.
• AI Language Buddy chat: ask about slang, grammar or usage, get extra examples without leaving the screen, and save the explanation to your vocabulary.
📺 Dual subtitles on the video you already watch
Watch with two lines on screen: the original subtitle and your language below it. It works as a dual subtitles extension on every supported site. If a video has no track in your language, the AI subtitle translator (paid plans and the free trial) can build the second line for you on the fly.
Supported platforms include:
➤ Netflix
➤ YouTube
➤ Prime Video
➤ HBO Max
➤ Disney+
➤ Crunchyroll
➤ Coursera
➤ Udemy
➤ LinkedIn Learning
➤ TED
The full list of supported sites: intersub.cc/en/how_to#skip_intro 
Turn on netflix dual subtitles for a series in the evening and youtube dual subtitles for a lecture in the morning: the settings stay the same everywhere. People also call it netflix double subtitles or netflix two subtitles; double subtitles on any supported site work the same way.
🔎 Translator extension with a pop-up dictionary
1⃣ Hover a word in the subtitles. The video pauses and a pop-up dictionary shows the translation.
2⃣ Read the context translation: the words around it are translated too, so slang and idioms make sense.
3⃣ Double-click or select text on any website. The same dictionary extension works on articles and forums.
4⃣ Ask the AI language tutor to translate meaning, grammar or a cultural reference in plain words. It's AI language learning built around your own questions.
This language translator extension recognises phrases, idioms and phrasal verbs, not only single words, so it works as an instant translator for real speech. On YouTube it doubles as a youtube translator extension for comments and descriptions too.
📚 Vocabulary builder with a full learning cycle
Most vocabulary apps give you someone else's word list. Here the list is built from the words you actually met in a scene or an article, so you learn new words you already care about.
How the cycle works:
 Find a word in a film, a series or on a website.
 It is saved to your vocabulary builder together with the sentence it came from.
 Practise it in our Telegram bot ( t.me/InterSubWords_bot?start=ff_as ). It breaks each word down into translation, usage and examples, checks the sentences you write with an AI tutor and brings the word back with spaced repetition. You can even answer by voice.
 Meet the word again in the next episode and understand it without help.
Prefer flashcards? You can also sync your words with Anki or export them to Excel. The bot follows the same idea as the extension. It stays simple and works with the words you chose yourself.
🧠 Learn from your own words
Sentence mining is simple here, with no extra add-ons to set up: every word keeps the line it came from, so you review it in context. If you use Anki, you can sync these words there too.
🎧 Modes for immersion language learning
▸ Show subtitles only on pause to train your listening.
▸ Hide the second line until you pause, then check yourself.
▸ Shadowing mode stops after each line so you can repeat it out loud. It's a simple way to practise shadowing english with real dialogue.
▸ Change font size, colour and position; right-to-left languages such as Arabic and Hebrew display correctly.
📱 Remote control from your phone
Watching on a TV or a big monitor? Scan a QR code and your phone becomes a remote: pause, rewind a line and tap a word in the current subtitle to see its translation, without leaving the sofa.
🌍 Languages you can learn
It supports dozens of languages. Popular directions include english to spanish and spanish to english, english to japanese, english to chinese and german to english. Fans who learn japanese with anime get the same tools on anime platforms, and crunchyroll ai subtitles help when an episode has no track in your language.
💡 What you get
• One app instead of three: dual subs, a pop-up dictionary and a vocabulary builder.
• Language learning with netflix and YouTube without stopping to search in another tab. It works as a netflix language learning extension.
• One of the language learning tools that covers both watching and review.
• A google translate alternative for words in context: you see what the word means in this exact sentence.
• ChatGPT translation help: ask the AI why a phrase means what it means.
• An alternative to Language Reactor, Immersive Translate, Dualsub or Trancy for learners who want both subtitles and word practice.
• Your words follow you to the phone through the Telegram bot.
❓ Frequently asked questions
Q: Is InterSub free?
A: Yes. Dual subs are free. The free plan includes a limited number of word lookups each month; Premium removes the limit and adds AI translation of subtitles.
Q: Does the translator extension work outside video?
A: Yes. Select or double-click any word on a website to see the translation.
Q: Is the Telegram bot free?
A: Yes. On the free plan you can bring 5 words from your InterSub dictionary into the bot; any paid plan makes it unlimited. You can also add your own word lists.
Q: Do I need Anki?
A: No. Words are saved in your dictionary and you can practise them in our Telegram bot. Anki sync is there if you already use it.
Questions or ideas? Write to us at intersub.cc or join our community on Discord: discord.com/invite/AgdxpVmHhb

firefox-addons:966535.description:

 Simple & Instant:

 🚀 New Power Features (v1.3): 
We now support Firefox Tab Groups and offer granular control! Visit the extension settings to choose from 5 distinct shuffling modes:
 Shuffle Top-Level: Randomizes ungrouped tabs and moves entire groups around without breaking them.
 Shuffle Within Groups: Keeps your groups where they are, but randomizes the tabs inside them.
 Shuffle Current Group: Focused chaos—only shuffles the tabs in your currently active group.
 Full Shuffle: deeply randomizes everything – groups and their internal tabs.
 Dissolve & Shuffle: The ultimate reset—ungroups all tabs and shuffles the entire window.
 Customizable: 
Configure your preferred default action and how "ungrouped" tabs are handled in the improved Options page.
Randomize as often as you like!

bluejetty:00180206:ios.summary:
ScanFood — Smart Nutrition Tracking
ScanFood is an app for anyone who wants to control their nutrition and reach their goals — whether it’s weight loss, muscle gain, or maintaining current shape.
The app makes calorie tracking simple, fas
bluejetty:00180206:ios.description:
ScanFood — Smart Nutrition Tracking
ScanFood is an app for anyone who wants to control their nutrition and reach their goals — whether it’s weight loss, muscle gain, or maintaining current shape.
The app makes calorie tracking simple, fast, and convenient.
AI-BASED CALORIE RECOGNITION
Just take a photo of your meal — ScanFood uses artificial intelligence to recognize the food and calculate calories, proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
This is especially useful when:
• there is no product packaging
• you are eating in a café or restaurant
• you don’t want to enter data manually
PRODUCT SCANNING AND ACCURATE TRACKING
You can also:
• Scan product barcodes and get detailed nutrition information
• Enter portion weight — the app will calculate everything automatically
• Add new products if they are not in the database (they will become available to other users)
FITNESS APP SYNCHRONIZATION
ScanFood syncs with Apple Fitness and takes your physical activity into account when calculating your daily calorie needs.
PERSONALIZED RECOMMENDATIONS
The app provides:
• Physical activity recommendations
• Nutrition tips
• Support in achieving your goals, whether it’s weight loss or muscle gain
REMINDERS AND FLEXIBLE SETTINGS
• Meal reminders
• Ability to change goals and daily calorie targets
• Full control of your nutrition in one app
SUBSCRIPTION
The app offers subscription options.
• Payment is charged to your iTunes account upon confirmation of purchase
• Subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Renewal is charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
• Subscriptions can be managed in Account Settings
Terms of Use:
https://appscanfood.com/terms.html

bluejetty:00071191:ios.name: Archers Online: PvP
bluejetty:00071191:ios.summary:
Get ready to master Archers Online, an epic PvP archery adventure game that puts you in the heat of archero duels, where only the best archer warrior wins!
Become the ultimate archer hero in a variety of PvP archer fights, facing off again
bluejetty:00071191:ios.description:
Get ready to master Archers Online, an epic PvP archery adventure game that puts you in the heat of archero duels, where only the best archer warrior wins!
Become the ultimate archer hero in a variety of PvP archer fights, facing off against shadow warriors and archery masters from around the world. Let's find out who has the strongest bow, the sharpest arrows, and the best aim in this challenging casual game!
Engage in exciting two-player online duels, in which you can either face strangers or challenge your friends in bowman war. Stick fight your way through each level, carefully judging the wind and angles to ensure your arrows always hit their mark. Whether you're battling in a shadow fight or facing off in a bright arena, you'll need all your skill to win these archery duels.
Show off your archery fighter prowess and conquer the bowman games with your powerful bows and diverse arrow arsenal. Whether you're slinging a bomb arrow, a burning arrowhead, or an armor-piercing cactus, you'll make your opponents quiver with fear. Every arrow game in this archers battle is a fresh and exciting challenge.
When you're not shooting, hit the anvil to upgrade your bow and shield, preparing your archer warrior for the next bow and arrow game. Your character's equipment can be the difference between victory and defeat, so make sure you're fully equipped before you enter the archery arena.
Victory in each archer fight brings spoils: coins and chests packed with resources. These can be used to upgrade your skins and equipment, making you an even more formidable archer fighter. Mastering these bowman games will reward you with even more bonuses, with daily quests and archery seasons offering a plethora of additional prizes.
As you progress in this captivating casual game, you'll move across the map and unlock new arenas. Each arena brings tougher opponents, so stay sharp and continue upgrading your bow master skills. And with a diverse range of beautiful landscapes – from atmospheric jungles to rainy city streets and ancient vine-covered ruins – you'll always have a new stunning location to enjoy as you level up.
Archers Online also features a training arena, where you can refine your skills before you step into the bowman war. Here you can experiment with different bow types, learn how to compensate for wind speed, and perfect your arrow aim.
But Archers Online isn't just about fighting - you can also chat with your opponents during the battles, exchange archery emoji, and even make friends. Just because you're in a bowman battle, doesn't mean you can't enjoy some friendly banter!
Your character can be customized with a variety of accessories, ensuring you always stand out in the crowd of archers games. Whether it's cool hats, flashy bow skins, or unique pennant stickers, there's plenty of ways to express your style.
Archers Online combines addictive gameplay, gorgeous graphics, and rewarding progression in one immersive shooter adventure. So, what are you waiting for? Dive into a world of endless multiplayer mayhem and bow-slinging fun, and show everyone who the true archer hero is!

bluejetty:00065765:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00065765:ios.description:
Please make sure your device has 4GB or more of RAM 
Amazing Frog? is like a kid-friendly version of "Grand Theft Auto" with action-packed chaos and toadally potty humour. Parkour through the town of Swindon, United Kingdom as a ridiculous farting ragdoll frog. Fly beyond the walls to uncover the many mysteries of Swindonshire! Join the fun in single player or 2 player split-screen co-op!
Start your Quest to unlock the Magical Mystery Toilet!
- Jump around town: Bounce on trampolines, soar through the air in cannons, and explore every nook and cranny.
- Unlock Exciting Rewards: Collect new gear and equipment to help traverse Swindonshire
- Find new costumes!: Get in brown portaloos to discover new outfits
- Dress to impress!: Customize your frog in hideout’s blue portaloos 
Will you be a good Swindon Citizen?
Do Good Deeds: Rescue cute kittens, tidy up the town and defeat zombies to earn Swindon Citizen Points (SCP).
Or Bring Chaos?
Cause explosions while jumping, driving or using bombs! Shoot stuff, create chaos and mayhem! Terrorize the citizens of Swindonshire! 
Action Adventure Awaits!
- Driving: Test your skills with various vehicles like cars, trucks, buggies, bikes, mopeds, and mobility scooters.
- Flying: Take to the skies with jets, airplanes, helicopters, drones, and jetpacks.
- Ride the Waves: Find airboats, jet skis, and boats to explore the surrounding waters.
Fight for survival!
Swindonshire is home to tons of enemies to fight like zombies, sharks, alligators and skeletons! 
- Weapons: Use a wide range of weapons including pistols, bombs, poop guns, and grapple hooks.
- Melee Combat: Engage in hand-to-hand combat with swords, bats, fish, and axes.
- Explosives: Use bombs, explosive barrels, and RPGs for max damage.
 Spawn Anywhere!
 Find locations around Swindonshire like the Mountain, Swindon-on-Sea and an island with aggressive inhabitants! Enter the orange portaloos to respawn back into if your die. Use the spawn point app in the phone to teleport back to every spawn point you have entered!
Discover New Worlds!
Look for secret entrances to alternative versions of Swindon like the wintery, Snow World and terrifying hellscape in Blood World. Get flying lessons in Flight School! Trudge through the treacherous underground sewer and reignite the abandoned Swindon Space Program. Take a rocket to the Moon and explore the lunar landscape
Features :
- Experiment with the limits of what's possible with the physics simulator, mess around with jet packs, grapple hook, objects and also the inhabitants of Swindon
- Find costumes across the map and customise your Frog! 
- Collect items like berries, sandwiches, ammo, skulls, mushrooms, poop. (They will be useful soon)
- Break out the Crown and start the coronation!
- Connect two controllers to play multiplayer split-screen in the main game and Party Mode!
Controller Compatible and touch screen compatible.
We are constantly working on optimising the game to as many devices as possible including improvements made on the quality settings to support devices with less RAM.
its the official Amazing Frog? iOS version from Fayju x

bluejetty:00024812:ios.name: Solitaire for Seniors
bluejetty:00024812:ios.summary: Remember the satisfaction of a well-played game of Solitaire in the good old days? Solebon’s Classic Style Solitaire brings back that timeless experience thoughtfully crafted for seniors like you! With a player-first design featuring large
bluejetty:00024812:ios.description:
Remember the satisfaction of a well-played game of Solitaire in the good old days? Solebon’s Classic Style Solitaire brings back that timeless experience thoughtfully crafted for seniors like you! With a player-first design featuring large card faces, intuitive controls, and unlimited undo moves, packed with hints and autoplay, detailed performance stats, and a leaderboard, every game promises a breath of fresh air in this classic game of Solitaire. 
Here at Solebon, we've been leaders in mobile gaming for decades. As creators of award-winning games like Letterpress and 2048, our Solebon Solitaire was recruited by Apple to launch with the App Store in 2008! With multiple card games in our portfolio, we proudly present Solitaire for Seniors, our most advanced game ever for the Boomer generation, because why should Gen-Z have all the fun?
This Solitaire is a take on the classic card game Patience, offering a relaxing and engaging gaming experience, perfect for those seeking a calming and mentally stimulating pastime.
Easy on the Eyes, Easy to Play:
Oversized Card Faces: Forget squinting at tiny fonts. Our oversized cards ensure comfortable and enjoyable gameplay.
Intuitive Design: Simple tap-to-move and drag-and-drop mechanics make playing a breeze. There aren't any complicated options or confusing controls, just simple gaming and pure fun!
Guaranteed Fun and Relaxation:
Winning Deals: We understand the frustration of unsolvable puzzles. With our Solitaire for Seniors, every deal is guaranteed to have a solution, keeping you motivated and engaged.
Helpful Hints: If you need a little nudge in the right direction, our gentle hints guide you to victory without spoiling the fun of challenges.
Track Progress & Celebrate Your Victories: Monitor your performance and see how you improve over time with detailed statistics, leaderboards, and personal best scores. What's more? Enjoy satisfying winning animations as you clear the board. 
Stress-Free Gameplay: Relax and unwind with calming visuals and smooth animations. Enjoy a moment of peace away from the daily grind and revisit the old memories of playing cards with friends!
More Than Just a Game:
Sharpen Your Mind: Studies show that regular Solitaire play can improve cognitive skills and memory. Keep your mind active and engaged in a fun and rewarding way.
Personalized Experience: Customize your game with various card styles, backgrounds, and even your own photos for card backs! Adjust card speed, sound levels, and hint delays per your requirements!
Plus, Enjoy Additional Features!
Undo Moves & Replay the last Deal: Made a mistake? Simply undo your previous move and try again. Never worry about making a wrong move with the replay deal option.
Foundation Auto-Play: Just tap the Auto button and play all eligible cards into the foundation piles.
Play Anytime and Anywhere: Our Classic Solitaire works on both iPhones and iPads and doesn't require an internet connection. Sync your game across multiple devices and pick up where you left off.
A Game for Everyone:
New to Mobile Gaming? No problem! This Solitaire for Seniors is perfect for beginners. We'll guide you through the game and help you get on board the digital gaming space with simple tutorials.
If you are an experienced card player, challenge yourself with various settings, including drawing 1 or 3 cards and left-handed play.
Download Solebon’s Solitaire for Seniors for free today!
Restart your Solitaire journey with our Solitaire for Seniors, especially curated for the evergreen boomer generation, & rediscover the joy of classic card games designed for your enjoyment!
For support and answers to frequently asked questions, head over to http://www.solebon.com/support.html. Follow us on Twitter @SolebonApp. Like us on Facebook https://www.facebook.com/SolebonApp.
Privacy Policy: http://www.solebon.com/legalese.html.
EULA: http://www.solebon.com/legalese.html.

bluejetty:00174740:ios.description:
Remote control for Canon EOS and PowerShot cameras. Capture flawless self-portraits, breathtaking travel shots, professional real-estate photos, stunning time-lapses, and more. (See a list of supported camera models at the end of this description.)
WHY YOU’LL LOVE SHUTTER+
• Connect wirelessly or use a USB cable.
• Easily browse, filter and download photos from the camera.
• Add GPS location to your photos.
• Compose perfect shots with aspect ratios and grid overlays.
• Nail down exposure with tools like RGB, histogram, zebras and false color.
• Exposure bracketing & BULB support.
• Include yourself in the photo - configurable delay and interval for repeated capture (intervalometer).
• Audio cues for countdown and shutter.
• Optimized for low battery usage.
PERFECT FOR EVERY PHOTOGRAPHER
Self-portraits & group shots
Set the timer, join the scene, and let Shutter+ take multiple frames so everyone looks their best.
Travel photography
Capture sunrises, sunsets, and landmark shots — no strangers, no cut-off limbs.
Real-estate & interiors
Use composition tools to line up the shot, and exposure bracketing to preserve detail in bright and dark areas.
Astrophotography
Stack multiple exposures for sharp, noise-free images of the Milky Way and Northern Lights.
Social media & lifestyle
Compose, pose, and shoot as many takes as you want — without relying on anyone else.

bluejetty:00079726:ios.description:
Manga Man, an application dedicated to comic enthusiasts, offers an immersive experience in the world of manga and comics. As soon as you launch the app, you're greeted with a sleek and visually appealing interface that sets the stage for an incredible reading journey.
The home screen of Manga Man is thoughtfully designed, featuring vibrant thumbnails of the latest and most popular manga series. With just a tap, you can explore a vast library of manga from various genres, including action, romance, fantasy, and more. The app boasts an extensive collection, catering to diverse tastes and ensuring there's something for everyone.
Navigating through the chapters and pages of a manga is a breeze with Manga Man's intuitive and user-friendly interface. You can swipe left or right to effortlessly flip through the pages or use the convenient navigation bar to jump to a specific chapter. The seamless reading experience, coupled with high-resolution images, brings the captivating artwork and storytelling to life on your screen.
Manga Man also offers personalized features to enhance your reading experience. You can create your own library, bookmark your favorite series, and receive notifications when new chapters are released. The app's recommendation system intelligently suggests similar manga based on your preferences, allowing you to discover exciting titles that align with your interests.
Furthermore, Manga Man provides a platform for manga enthusiasts to connect and engage with each other. You can join vibrant communities, discuss your favorite series, and share recommendations with like-minded readers. The app fosters a sense of camaraderie among manga fans, creating a lively and interactive environment.
With its vast manga collection, user-friendly interface, and engaging community features, Manga Man stands out as a premier application for comic lovers. Whether you're a long-time manga enthusiast or just dipping your toes into the world of comics, Manga Man promises an unforgettable reading experience right at your fingertips.

bluejetty:00043786:ios.summary:
Your VeVe collection, connected.

AUTOMATIC COLLECTION
Spend less time updating your collection manually. Connect your wallet and le
bluejetty:00043786:ios.description:
Your VeVe collection, connected.
Track your collectibles and comics, follow market movements, and explore your collection with VaultValue.
AUTOMATIC COLLECTION
Spend less time updating your collection manually. Connect your wallet and let VaultValue sync your collectibles and comics, track your holdings, and calculate their estimated value using marketplace floor prices.
Automatic Collection is available with VaultValue CLUB. Prefer managing things yourself? You can also create a collection manually.
A COMPLETELY NEW LOOK
Discover a modern Liquid Glass design throughout the app, with refreshed screens, smoother navigation, and layouts designed for both iPhone and iPad.
EXPLORE THE MARKET
Browse collectibles and comics, follow your watchlist, discover upcoming drops, and explore price history and collectible activity. View richer VeVe profiles, including collector levels and MCP ranks.
GET NOTIFIED
Create alerts for the events you want to follow:
- Floor price: set a target and receive an alert when it is reached or crossed in either direction. Choose a one-time alert or a notification at every crossing.
- Mint activity: follow a specific mint and get notified when its token is minted on the blockchain or transferred to another wallet.
- New listings: watch an exact mint number across the catalog, or selected collectibles and comics with an exact mint number or any mint.
Edit or pause your rules at any time. Find your notifications in one inbox and pin the ones you want to keep.
You can also set reminders for upcoming drops and waitlist openings.
GO FURTHER WITH VAULTVALUE CLUB
Unlock an ad-free experience and advanced tools for your collection:
- Automatic Collection with wallet syncing.
- Detailed collectible insights and price charts.
- Token Hunter to explore individual editions and available ownership information.
- Listing Explorer to find listings for the mint numbers you follow.
- Wallet Analyzer to explore a wallet's collection.
- MCP Calculator to estimate daily MCP points.
Keep your collection's estimated value close at hand with the redesigned Home Screen widget.
AVAILABLE IN 7 LANGUAGES
English, French, Spanish, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.
Collection values are estimates based on marketplace data and may differ from actual sale prices.

bluejetty:00065533:ios.description:
Order healthy school lunch right from your iPhone!
Choicelunch has been redefining "school lunch" by making food kids love and parents are proud of. We believe wholesome food and kid appeal are not opposing forces, and offer a kid-friendly menu that's fresh prepared from the best ingredients. By pre-ordering what you want, when you want it from our expansive menu, parents can accommodate their child's food needs and preferences while saving hours a week in the kitchen.
And now you can do it all from your iPhone! With the Choicelunch app you can browse the Choicelunch menu, order lunches, view lunches already on order, cancel lunches in advance, and view all entrée information, including nutritional facts and allergen, and entrée descriptions and pictures.
Key Features:
-Order lunches from the school calendar
-View the lunches you've already ordered
-Cancel or change upcoming lunches
-Add/remove lunch add-ons
-Receive Push Notifications for Order Reminders (optional) or other important lunch updates
-View/manage/reload your Choicelunch Account Balance
-Sign-up for a new account
-Manage account and students
-Add/update/delete credit card details
-See size-specific photos and descriptions of entrées
-Menu is filtered by allergens for each student
-Set "Favorite" entrées for quick ordering
-Browse entrée nutritional information
Choicelunch provides healthy, wholesome school lunches to over 300 schools in California. If you have students at a school serving Choicelunch, be sure to create a registered account on www.choicelunch.com before using the iPhone app.
For more information on Choicelunch or assistance in setting up your registered user account, visit www.choicelunch.com or contact support@choicelunch.com.

bluejetty:00186280:ios.description:
PutNumber is a fun puzzle game you can play at your own pace!
Use your finger to slide the number blocks aligned below, and put them on any space on the board you'd like.
You'll need to skillfully group and erase blocks, taking care to place them in a way that doesn't make the board fill up.
■ How to play ■
・ Blocks are erased when you gather more blocks than the number written on the block.
・ Turn the blocks at the bottom around by tapping them.
・ Earn a higher score by erasing multiple numbers at once! (NUMBER LINK)
・ If you get a high score, you can use the C button to erase the selected numbers.
First, try playing at the nice and slow pace of ENDLESS Mode.
For people who want to enjoy the game for a shorter time or want a more intense play experience, we recommend TIMED Mode.
Beginning with version 3, a new mode CURSOR Mode has been added.
A completely free game app, PutNumber is popular for its reputation as a brain teaser that gives your mind a workout.
Since you can play at your leisure, it's perfect for killing time whether commuting or simply waiting.
It's super interesting, so please give it a try!
■ Production ■
AOTAKA STUDIO
Game Planning and Programming: TOKUDA TAKASHI
Game Graphic Design: TOKUDA AOI

bluejetty:00161461:ios.description:
What, When, Where, Why and Wow!
While Cosmos® is devoted to showing you the wonders of the world at an incredible value, our complimentary CosmosGO app was designed to put a world of invaluable pre- and on-trip information at your fingertips.
Up to 30 days prior to departure – and for the duration of your vacation – you can log in to check flight, hotel and transfer information, review your itinerary, and customize your trip with a host of entertainment, sightseeing, dining and shopping suggestions. Bistros, bars, bookstores, bakeries – they’re all in there! Best of all, when you’re enjoying the ample free time on your Cosmos vacation, you can safely wander without Wi-Fi and discover without draining data, as built-in GPS navigation works offline for on-trip ease.
Created to help you make the most of precious travel time, CosmosGO is a digital travel guide and journal in one, allowing you to also take trip notes, organize photos, and share your incredible Cosmos vacation experiences with friends and family on social media.
Download, discover and go!
• Stay in the know, on the go.
From your flight schedules and daily itineraries to hotel and transfer details, the CosmosGO app keeps you abreast of logistics throughout your vacation.
• Fuel your free time.
The CosmosGO app is loaded with restaurant, entertainment and sightseeing suggestions to make the most of your independent time.
• Wander and wonder without Wi-Fi.
Easily navigate local streets with GPS directions – without the need for Wi-Fi or cellular data.
• Pen it. Snap it. Post it.
Document your journey with notes and photos, and share your experiences with friends and family on social media.

bluejetty:00066102:ios.description:
Are you ready for a REAL fight?
The true Emperor has fallen. We need a real hero, a true Lord who can unite the Kingdoms. Recruit heroes from various backgrounds, from dwarves and mermaids to dark elves and steampunk robots, and assemble your army in this magical world! Fight and conquer to establish your empire in one of the strategy games!
[Game Features]:
▶▶ Embark on the Guild Expedition ◀◀
Experience a grand Guild vs Guild battle, where multiple guilds compete against each other to expand their territory. Troops will not perish in this special battleground, allowing you to unleash your full potential without any worries! Unite your guild and strategize to conquer the battlefield!
▶ ▶ Collect Artifacts! ◀◀
Discover ancient Artifacts in the Artifact Hall. Upgrade and enhance them to unlock their true power! 
▶ ▶ Build Your Own Kingdom ◀◀
Upgrade buildings, conduct research, train your troops, level your Heroes and lead your Kingdom well to prosper in this strategy game!
▶ ▶ Utilize Troop Formations ◀◀
4 different troop types, and 6 different troop formations for you to choose from! Plan your lineups, take advantage of the counter system, and pair your troops with the right Heroes! Perfect your strategy to defeat your enemies!
▶ ▶ Powerful Heroes Await ◀◀
Create a strong team of 5 Heroes to fight through an RPG-style campaign! Let them lead your kingdom to glory as war generals!
▶ ▶ Forge Alliances ◀◀
Join a guild to fight alongside your allies! Ride into war together to conquer various exhilarating events: Guild Wars, Kingdom Versus Kingdom battles, Battle Royals, Wonder Wars, Darknest Invasions, and much more!
▶ ▶ Clash Online with Global Players ◀◀
Brawl with millions of players from all over the world, and defeat those who stand in your way! Seize the throne and rule over all in this amazing strategy game!
▶ ▶ Animated Battles ◀◀
Experience the thrill of war as your armies clash in beautiful 3D graphics! Watch as your Heroes unleash their skills and harness their mystical power!

Our app features the latest breaking news that impacts you and your family, interactive weather and radar, and live video from our newscasts and local events.
LOCAL & BREAKING NEWS
• Receive real-time notifications for breaking news
• Read the latest news as it happens in your area
• Explore exclusive investigative stories
• Browse photos, news clips, and raw video

• Daily and hourly forecasts for your city
• The latest forecasts from our meteorologists
• Interactive radar maps
• Automated hyperlocal severe weather alerts
LIVE VIDEO
• Watch live video newscasts and breaking news from KAGS TV
PERSONALIZATION
• Discover and dive into topics that matter to you
• Favorite topics to receive personalized updates

• Share stories & videos directly with your friends and family
• See the latest updates and behind the scenes photos from your favorite anchors and reporters
• Get information on school delays & closings as they happen
• Cast videos and livestreams directly to your TV or streaming device, so you can lean back and enjoy your favorite programming on your biggest screen
This is the official app of KAGS and KAGSTV.com, the NBC affiliate serving College Station.

bluejetty:00120126:ios.description:
The #1 ground school for FAA Private Pilot, Instrument Rating, Commercial Pilot, and Flight Instructor. Free access to Basic Test Prep. Upgrade to Premium Test Prep or the complete Ground School course via in-app purchase (free trial available).
Free basic test prep includes:
▸ Basic question bank with hundreds of practice questions and explanations
▸ Practice sessions from missed questions, or review missed questions. 
▸ Simulated FAA exams administered under the same rules and time constraints as the actual exam. Unlike other test prep apps, our exams present the correct proportion of questions from each knowledge area per the ACS.
Upgrading to Ground School unlocks a complete ground school course that takes 15-35 hours to complete depending on the course. The course includes:
▸ An instructor endorsement after completing the course so that you can take the FAA exam. 
▸ Hundreds of additional questions to ensure thorough preparation for the knowledge test
▸ View definitions of key terms and acronyms in lessons and answer explanations.
▸ Detailed explanations and references for all questions, many with high resolution images
▸ SmartExam zeroes in on your weak areas to ensure thorough preparation for the FAA exam.
▸ Sync your data and course progress across on all of your iOS devices
▸ View statistics and progress. Proficiency is tracked using an algorithm that assigns a mastery level to each question. Stop wasting time answering questions you've already mastered.
▸ Share reports via iMessage, AirDrop, e-mail, and more
After you complete a course you can review all completed lessons and access all lesson questions. Unlike other ground school providers, we do not limit your access to one year, and all future updates are free. Ground School courses are available for:
Private Pilot
Instrument Rating
Commercial Pilot
Flight Instructor Airplane
Flight Instructor Instrument Add-On
================================
Non-US citizens who can read, write, speak, and understand English may obtain a US pilot certificate per FAR 61.65, 61.103, and 61.123.

- Learn Japanese, English, Chinese speaking and listening with HD videos

- Practice listening and speaking comprehensively

⭐️ PRACTICE LISTENING JAPANESE

>> Practice listening Japanese online and offline

>> Japanese listening practice through songs
>> Shadowing Japanese

>> Learning video Japanese
>> Japanese communication work

Voiky is suitable for those who want to learn Chinese communication, practice listening and speaking Chinese easily and effectively at home. Voiky has over 3000+ videos of diverse topics: study, culture, music, news, etc. Suitable for all learners of Chinese from beginners to intermediate and advanced.
⭐️ PRACTICE LISTENING AND SPEAKING ENGLISH
Practice listening and speaking English through video
Do exercises to strengthen your English reflexes - an important foundation for good English communication. Get rid of boredom with effective English listening and speaking method with Voiky
Vivid illustrations in the video: stimulate memory and interest in learning
Video learning at an adjustable speed: Learning like a child acquires language
Learn and practice: practice immediately with important words you have saved
📩 READY TO SOLVE YOUR ISSUES AND FEEDBACK
Voiky Japanese - Chinese - English listening and speaking practice app is looking forward to receiving your feedback, which helps Voiky improve better and better.
If you have any feedback, please email us: voiky@eupgroup.net

bluejetty:00129421:ios.name: Drawing Photo Editor
bluejetty:00129421:ios.summary:
** Drawing Photo Editor - Transform Your Photos into Hand-Drawn Masterpieces **
Experience the fusion of photography and art with Drawing Photo Editor, the ultimate camera app designed to turn your photos into stunning hand-drawn artworks.
bluejetty:00129421:ios.description:
** Drawing Photo Editor - Transform Your Photos into Hand-Drawn Masterpieces **
Experience the fusion of photography and art with Drawing Photo Editor, the ultimate camera app designed to turn your photos into stunning hand-drawn artworks. This innovative app comes equipped with live filters that allow you to adjust effects in real-time, giving you full control over your creative vision with just a swipe of your finger. From intricate sketches to vibrant cartoons, oil paintings, poster art, woodblock prints, and fabric canvas images, Drawing Photo Editor offers a wide range of filters that cater to every artistic style.
Key Features:
1. Live Filter Adjustment:
Drawing Photo Editor features real-time filter adjustments, enabling you to see the effects as you shoot. Simply swipe the slider to fine-tune the intensity of the filter, ensuring that every shot is perfect.
2. Extensive Collection of Hand-Drawn Filters:
Explore a vast array of hand-drawn style filters that add a unique artistic touch to your photos. Whether you want to create detailed sketches, comic book styles, bold oil paintings, intricate poster art, or fabric canvas images, Drawing Photo Editor has the perfect filter for you.
3. Unique Artistic Filters Beyond Hand-Drawn Effects:
In addition to hand-drawn filters, Drawing Photo Editor offers a plethora of unique filters such as pixel art, CGA graphics, distorted images, grid layouts, and more. These filters provide a creative twist to your photos, making them truly stand out.
4. Silent Shutter Mode:
The silent shutter mode is perfect for capturing candid moments without disturbing your subject. Whether you're photographing wildlife, a sleeping baby, or a quiet environment, the silent shutter ensures that you can shoot discreetly and confidently.
5. Adjustable Aspect Ratios:
Customize your photos to fit your desired aspect ratio with ease. Drawing Photo Editor allows you to switch effortlessly between portrait and landscape modes, providing the flexibility to suit your composition needs.
6. Built-In Lighting for Low Light Conditions:
Capture clear and detailed photos even in low light conditions with the app's built-in lighting feature. Illuminate your subjects and bring out their best features, regardless of the lighting environment.
7. Front and Rear Camera Support:
Seamlessly switch between the front and rear cameras to take selfies or capture the world around you. Both cameras are fully supported with all the app's features, ensuring high-quality photos from any angle.
8. Intuitive User Interface:
Drawing Photo Editor boasts an intuitive and user-friendly interface that makes navigating the app a breeze. Whether you're a seasoned photographer or a casual user, you'll find it easy to access and utilize all the powerful features this app has to offer.
9. High-Quality Output:
All photos taken with Drawing Photo Editor maintain high resolution and quality, ensuring that your hand-drawn masterpieces look professional and polished.
Why Drawing Photo Editor Stands Out:
Drawing Photo Editor is crafted for those who love to infuse their photos with artistic flair and creativity. Whether you're a professional photographer seeking new tools to enhance your work or a casual user looking to have fun with your photos, this app provides everything you need to create stunning visuals effortlessly. The wide range of filters and effects ensures that there's always something new to explore, while the real-time adjustments give you complete control over your artistic expression.
Drawing Photo Editor is your gateway to transforming ordinary photos into extraordinary hand-drawn artworks. Download now and start creating your masterpieces today!

bluejetty:00184951:ios.summary:
Pop & Explode Cubes!
It’s time to join the fun adventure and start blasting tiles! Match and crash 2 or more adjacent cubes of the same color to explode and clear the board, make special combos and explore hundreds of super fun puzzle level
bluejetty:00184951:ios.description:
Pop & Explode Cubes!
It’s time to join the fun adventure and start blasting tiles! Match and crash 2 or more adjacent cubes of the same color to explode and clear the board, make special combos and explore hundreds of super fun puzzle levels. Crushing blocks is absolutely free and totally addictive! 
Train your brain and test your puzzle solving skills in playing this easy and relaxing game. Get ready for the best adventure through new levels, discover plenty of awesome puzzles and quests and win amazing boosts that will help you pass tricky challenges in this journey. 
Download today and crash your way around all the tricky puzzles and tapping challenges! 
Test your color matching skills in hundreds of new levels, clear the obstacles and win boosters. Enjoy hours of fun, and tap and explode the bricks to blast them away. The more toys you pop in one move, the better the chance you’ll unlock a cool booster that will help you defeat the challenge. 
Use the cool power-ups and boosts at the right time to crush tiles, clear the board and win awesome prizes! Enjoy smooth, addictive gameplay, beautiful designs, and the best tap 2 game puzzles. Challenge family and friends and see who can complete all the missions - it’s a fun and super addictive tap 2 game!
HOW TO PLAY POWER POP BLAST:
- Click on any 2 adjacent toys of the same color to drag and blast them.
- Play through hundreds of challenging and popping levels in this cool cubes game. 
- Overcome obstacles, collect gems and diamonds and beat the levels.
- Clear the board from the bricks and win points. 
- Use powerful boosts to advance through the blast game. 
Join the block tapping fun today!
You have a limited amount of moves to clear a level in this journey, so you better think it through and plan your path wisely.
Pop the cubes and win awesome rewards. 
- Touch and crush 5 or 6 tiles to get a rocket.
- Match and crash 7 or 8 cubes to get a bomb.
- Swipe and smash bricks to earn a color wheel
AMAZING FEATURES:
- Colorful graphics and designs.
- Fantastic and unique gameplay, tap and smash 2 blocks to blast.
- Tons of fun puzzles and challenges. 
- Easy and fun to learn blast game. 
- Completely FREE to play!
- Swap and explode all the tiles, and blast the puzzles in this matching game whenever and wherever you want - no wifi or internet needed!
Play this amazing popping game today, and start the fun! You won’t regret playing this great tap 2 block game!
Liked the game? We would love to get your feedback! Let us know what we can add to make your gameplay even more enjoyable and earn your 5-star review. 
Power Pop Blast is free to play, but some optional in-game items will require payment.

bluejetty:00062051:ios.name: Car games and puzzles for kids
bluejetty:00062051:ios.summary: Cars puzzle is a fun and educational game for toddlers, specially young boys. Learn names and sounds, while playing 80 different transportation puzzles – some of them are planes, train, police car, school bus, truck, ship, space rocket, fir
bluejetty:00062051:ios.description:
Cars puzzle is a fun and educational game for toddlers, specially young boys. Learn names and sounds, while playing 80 different transportation puzzles – some of them are planes, train, police car, school bus, truck, ship, space rocket, fire engine, hot air balloon and horse cart.
Each jigsaw style puzzle when completed, gives them the sound of the vehicle as well as the word with pronunciation to build their vocabulary. Watch your baby play for hours and help them to develop spatial, matching, cognitive, memory, tactile and fine motor skills all at the same time. This jigsaw puzzle game is full of sounds, animations and interactivity for repeat game play.
And now we have added 3 more new themes:
* Placing the objects in a scene
* Jigsaw puzzle
* Memory game
Features:
Simple & intuitive child-friendly interface
Universal app for all phones and tablets
30 different languages and pronunciations - English, Afrikaans, Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, Danish, Dutch, Filipino, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hindi, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Macedonian, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Serbian, Spanish, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese.
Hundreds of pieces in 80 different puzzles
Easy navigation between puzzles
Easy movement of puzzle pieces across screen
High-quality pictures and images
Sweet background melodies
Drag & drop animations
Balloon animation & happy cheering after each correctly solved puzzle
The theme of this Puzzle is ‘Vehicles’, check our other apps for more themes like ‘Animals’, 'Food', 'Bath', 'Kitchen', 'Furniture' and 'Tools'
Feedback Please:
If you have any feedback and suggestions on how we could further improve the design and interaction of our apps and games, please visit our website http://iabuzz.com or leave us a message at kids@iabuzz.com. We would be glad to hear from you as we are committed to update all of our apps and games on a regular basis with new free features.

bluejetty:00175932:ios.name: Envelope Printer Labels
bluejetty:00175932:ios.summary:
Design and print beautiful envelopes in minutes with Envelope Printer!
From wedding invitations to business mail, Envelope Printer gives you a full design studio for the front of your envelope — start from a professional template or a blan
bluejetty:00175932:ios.description:
Design and print beautiful envelopes in minutes with Envelope Printer!
From wedding invitations to business mail, Envelope Printer gives you a full design studio for the front of your envelope — start from a professional template or a blank canvas, make it yours, and print right from your iPhone, iPad, or Mac. Designing is completely free; the app has a limited free plan for printing and exporting, and a paid subscription for unlimited output.
Key Features:
• 100 Professional Templates: A curated library across Business, Weddings, Holidays, and Birthdays — elegant scripts, modern type, wax seals, florals, borders, and more. Tap one and start editing.
• A True Design Editor: Move and resize anything. Hundreds of beautiful typefaces, rich text styling (color, size, bold, italic, underline, alignment, line spacing), center-snap guides, and full undo/redo.
• AI Envelope Assistant: Describe what you want and watch it design your envelope — restyle layouts, generate logos, monograms, and artwork, or add a QR code, all from a simple chat.
• Bulk Addressing in Seconds: Paste a list of names or a CSV and the AI creates one addressed envelope per contact, keeping your return address on every one. Perfect for invitations and holiday cards.
• Add Images and QR Codes: Insert photos, logos, stamps, AI-generated art, or scannable QR codes for a personal or professional touch.
• Every Envelope Size: #10, #9, DL, A7, A6, square, catalog, baronial, and many more — or enter custom dimensions in inches, centimeters, or millimeters.
• Print-Perfect Output: Print directly to any AirPrint printer at full print resolution, or export a crisp PDF (one page per envelope) to share or print anywhere. Built-in guidance helps you load envelopes and match paper sizes.
• Favorites: Save your designs and reopen them anytime — your go-to layouts are always one tap away.
• Made for iPhone, iPad, and Mac: One app, everywhere you work.
Free Plan:
• Every template, the full editor, and all AI features — free
• A limited number of free exports (print, PDF, share)
Pro (subscription):
• Unlimited printing, PDF export, and sharing
Whether you're addressing a single letter or a whole guest list, Envelope Printer turns a chore into something you'll actually enjoy.
Download Envelope Printer today and make every envelope worth opening.
Enjoying the app? We'd love to hear from you! Please consider leaving a review to help others discover Envelope Printer.

Privacy:
