bluejetty:00078475:ios.name: Time Squared: Hours Tracker
bluejetty:00078475:ios.summary: Effortlessly track work hours, manage projects, and handle data collection for payroll and invoices with Time Squared—the all-in-one solution that turns time management into a walk in the park. Designed for employees, freelancers, business
bluejetty:00078475:ios.description:
Effortlessly track work hours, manage projects, and handle data collection for payroll and invoices with Time Squared—the all-in-one solution that turns time management into a walk in the park. Designed for employees, freelancers, business owners, and managers, Time Squared is packed with features to keep your workday organized and efficient.
[TRACK TIME ACCURATELY]
• Clock in and out with a tap, track breaks, and log time on tasks with built-in GPS location tracking, and set up automatic breaks for manual time entries.
[JOB & PROJECT MANAGEMENT]
• Create and manage projects with detailed entries, notes, and photos, categorizing by job type, clients, or location for seamless organization.
[EFFICIENT CREW MANAGEMENT]
• Assign roles, send invites, monitor activities, and manage clock-ins/outs, keeping tabs on your crew with real-time status updates.
[INSIGHTFUL DASHBOARD]
• View total tracked time, billable hours, and labor costs at a glance, with summaries of active projects, hours worked, and earnings.
[COMPREHENSIVE TIMESHEETS]
• Easily create and export timesheets with detailed logs of daily activities including start/end times and breaks, with manual entry options ensuring accurate logging with adjustable break times.
[EXPORT TIMESHEETS OPTIONS]
• Export work hour timesheets as spreadsheets to Excel, Sheets, OpenOffice, and more through email, text, or messaging apps.
[EASY PROJECT MANAGEMENT]
• Select projects or create new ones, reuse details for future logs, and archive completed projects for a clutter-free workspace.
[COLLECT PAYROLL DATA]
• Automatically calculate hours worked and earnings, supporting different rates and configuring overtime rules with multipliers for extra pay.
[DETAILED EARNINGS INTERFACE]
• Breakdown of hours worked, earnings, and labor costs per employee, with reports and editable employee rates and fees.
[GENERATE DATA FOR INVOICES & TRACK EXPENSES]
• Easily track time, expenses, mileage, tax rates, withholdings, and reimbursements with our project reports to simplify your invoice creation process outside the software.
[POWERFUL REPORTING & ANALYTICS]
• Generate custom reports to analyze earnings and hours, with detailed analysis by day, week, month, or custom periods for informed decision-making.
[DESKTOP WEB APP] 
• Seamlessly transition from mobile to desktop to view and edit employee times, download reports, and customize columns with our new desktop web app.
[DATA SECURITY & AUTOMATION]
• Automatic cloud backups ensure data security, with continuous time tracking even during device failures.
[NOTIFICATIONS AND ALERTS]
• Reminders for punch-out times and when timers go into overtime.
[PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION PLANS]
• Company accounts include team syncing, a 30-entry trial before requiring a subscription, and access to all advanced features such as priority support, location tracking on punch in/out, marking times as paid/unpaid, mileage tracking, and photo attachments.
• Individual accounts offer a freemium tier with ads and a premium plan that includes the same advanced features: priority support, location tracking on punch in/out, marking times as paid/unpaid, mileage tracking, photo attachments, and an ad-free experience.
▶ GET STARTED ◀
1. Download Time Squared and use it across your iPhone, iPad, other mobile and desktop devices.
2. Set up your profile and start tracking time, managing projects, and collecting payroll and invoice data..
3. Invite crew members and assign roles to streamline team management.
4. Use project reports to track expenses with ease.
5. Use detailed reporting and analytics to monitor performance and make informed decisions.
Download Time Squared today and revolutionize your time, project, and payroll management! Visit https://timesquared.co for more information.
--

Privacy policy: https://timesquared.co/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00170563:ios.name: ePhoto France
bluejetty:00170563:ios.summary:
Réalisez votre photo d’identité avec code ePhoto directement depuis votre smartphone.
Avec ePhoto France, prenez votre photo d’identité conforme aux normes administratives et obtenez votre code ePhoto officiel pour vos démarches en ligne :
bluejetty:00170563:ios.description:
Réalisez votre photo d’identité avec code ePhoto directement depuis votre smartphone.
Avec ePhoto France, prenez votre photo d’identité conforme aux normes administratives et obtenez votre code ePhoto officiel pour vos démarches en ligne : permis de conduire, titre de séjour, DCEM…
Une ePhoto est une photo d’identité numérique accompagnée d’une signature électronique.
Le code ePhoto est requis pour certaines démarches administratives en ligne, notamment sur le site de l’administration française.
Application conforme aux exigences du Ministère de l’Intérieur.
Grâce à notre technologie de vérification avancée associée à un contrôle humain, vos photos sont vérifiées pour garantir leur conformité aux normes officielles.
Plus besoin de chercher une cabine photo ou un photographe.
Réalisez vos photos d’identité directement chez vous, avec votre smartphone.
Notre solution est particulièrement adaptée pour :
- les bébés et enfants
- les personnes vivant en zone rurale
- les personnes à mobilité réduite
Prenez votre photo et obtenez votre code ePhoto et votre photo d’identité au bon format automatiquement.
Pour quelles démarches :
- Permis de conduire
- Titre de séjour
- DCEM (Document de circulation pour étranger mineur)
Ce que vous recevez :
- Votre photo d’identité conforme aux normes
- Votre signature numérique
- Votre code ePhoto
- Réception par email en moins d'une heure
Garantie :
Photo acceptée par l’administration ou 100 % remboursée.
Conseils pour réussir votre photo :
1 - Utilisez un fond uni et clair
2 - Regardez directement l’objectif
3 - Évitez toute ombre sur le visage
4 - Prenez la photo dans un endroit bien éclairé
Conseil : demandez l’aide d’un proche et utilisez la caméra arrière de votre smartphone.

bluejetty:00087062:ios.description:
Try new original approach to the minesweeper games genre!
The Infinite Minesweeper provides endless board filled with mines to uncover. As you can't solve the whole board*, its divided into 8x8 sectors. Solve a sector to score points. Do not fear revealing a mine! The sector will just lock, allowing you to unlock it by solving all adjacent sectors, watching an Ad or unlocking it using gems, which can be found on almost every sector. The further you explore the more difficult the sectors will appear. You can compete with other players on the leaderboards with daily, monthly or all time results.
Game contains three modes:- endless: the main one
- hardcore: for the steel nerved players where one mistakes results with losing whole progress on the board
- timed: solve as much sectors you can before time ends 
The endless game is truly relaxing and stressless experience. Just play, expand, and even when mistaken just wave it, you can just leave the locked sector and go on, the board is infinite!
Game contains shop with gem packs available for purchase. There is a banner ad that can by turned off by any gem purchase. Game contains video ads that can be watched to unlock sectors. You can customise the game looks with skins. There are two free skins available at the beginning - light and dark theme.
* at least not in your lifetime! The board is limited only by the technical limitations of the programming language used.

bluejetty:00059374:android.description:
This app brings private browsing, smooth video download and HD playback together in one clean and powerful app.
No more switching between multiple apps — browse, download and watch videos all in the same place. The built-in HD video player gives you clear, lag-free playback anytime you want, even without internet.
Video Downloader, Player & Launcher comes with a powerful Launcher that puts downloads, favorite sites, and tools instantly at your fingertips, plus a built-in Video Player for smooth playback. Launch videos, download content, and play files directly from one screen—no switching apps, no extra steps. Everything you need, faster and simpler, powered by the launcher.
🔥 What This App Offers.
• Easy HD video download from websites with auto-detect.
• High-quality video player with smooth controls.
• Supports multiple video formats and resolutions.
• Auto-save history and quick access to downloaded videos.
• Download manager with resume / pause / multiple downloads.
• Works fast with lightweight and user-friendly design.
🚀 Why This App Feels Better to Use.
• Download videos without complicated steps.
• Watch everything in HD quality.
• Fast performance designed for everyday users.
📌 How to Use This App.
Method A – Download through Video Downloader
1️⃣ Open the app and browse website
2️⃣ Play a video — app will detect it automatically.
3️⃣ Tap Download and choose video quality.
4️⃣ Enjoy the video later with the built-in player.
Method B – Download through video link.
1️⃣ Copy the video link from a website.
2️⃣ Open the app and paste the link.
3️⃣ Tap Download to save instantly.
Whichever method you choose, downloading is fast, simple and beginner-friendly.
🔐 User Responsibility.
This app supports saving videos only from websites that allow downloads.
Users should download and share content responsibly and with proper permission.
Enjoy the freedom to browse and save videos you like, and watch them anytime — all inside video downloader.

bluejetty:00138572:ios.developer: Maria de los Llanos Goig Monino
bluejetty:00138572:ios.summary:
El Diccionario Hebreo Bíblico más completo y práctico que puedas encontrar para tu dispositivo móvil o tablet.

bluejetty:00138572:ios.description:
El Diccionario Hebreo Bíblico más completo y práctico que puedas encontrar para tu dispositivo móvil o tablet.
Diccionario Hebreo Bíblico es una aplicación para aprender muy fácilmente el significado de las palabras bíblicas en hebreo. Dispone de un menú de fácil acceso desde el cual tendrás a mano todas las fichas con las definiciones de las palabras ordenadas alfabéticamente.
Ponemos a tu disposición muchos recursos sobre el hebreo, indispensables para conocer a fondo nuestra historia.
El Hebreo tiene su origen influenciado por varias lenguas-raíz semíticas Arameo (antecesores y derivados; las mismas que originaron el árabe, por ejemplo), además de que fue altamente enriquecido por el babilónico y el Fenicio.
El hebreo es una lengua con casi 30 siglos de historia escrita. Obviamente en un período tan largo la lengua ha sufrido procesos de cambio lingüístico que hacen del hebreo antiguo y el hebreo actual, más que la misma lengua puedan considerarse lenguas emparentadas pero que difieren en pronunciación, gramática y léxico.
Diccionario hebreo bíblico es ideal para utilizar como consulta en el estudio del hebreo bíblico y en la exégesis del texto de la Biblia Hebrea. Pero es mucho más que eso, es un texto muy didáctico. Disfrute aprendiendo todas las definiciones y amplíe su cultura bíblica.
Diccionario hebreo bíblico te trae entre otros los siguientes términos:
Dios, Adorar, Sacrificio, Pacto, Padre, Santificar ...
Para una mayor comprensión, la herramienta Diccionario Hebreo Bíblico contiene recursos bíblicos tan útiles como son La Torá y el Tanaj , Concordancias Bíblicas y un traductor hebreo, Biblia Hebraica escrita y en audio, en Hebreo, Tanaj en audio, Biblia Offline y muchos más.
Según la Biblia y las tradiciones hebraicas (orales y escritas), los hebreos fueron originarios de Mesopotamia. Eran nómadas, vivían en tiendas, poseían manadas de cabras y ovejas, utilizando asnos, mulas y camellos como portadores. Siguiendo a Abraham, los hebreos emigraron hacia Canaán, la tierra prometida por Dios a los descendientes del primer patriarca. Varias tablillas descubiertas en Mari certifican frecuentes migraciones a través del Creciente Fértil.
El alefato o alfabeto hebreo, algunas veces denominado mediante su forma hebrea álef-bet2 (אָלֶף-בֵּית), es la serie formada por las consonantes hebreas. Está compuesto por 22 caracteres, de los cuales cinco tienen una grafía distinta al final de las palabras. Se utiliza para escribir el idioma hebreo, el yidish y, en menor medida, el judeoespañol.
Descarga ahora Diccionario Hebreo Bíblico y expande tu conocimiento aprendiendo el significado de las palabras bíblicas en hebreo. 
Si tienes cualquier cuestión o duda o deseas contribuir en algo, por favor, háznoslo saber. Gracias
Dios les Bendiga.

bluejetty:00027625:ios.name: MixEffect (Trial & Pro Unlock)
bluejetty:00027625:ios.summary:
MixEffect is a professional tool for controlling Blackmagic Design ATEM switchers from your iPhone or iPad. 
MixEffect’s familiar interface gives you quick access to virtually everything you need to run your video productions: switcher con
bluejetty:00027625:ios.description:
MixEffect is a professional tool for controlling Blackmagic Design ATEM switchers from your iPhone or iPad. 
MixEffect’s familiar interface gives you quick access to virtually everything you need to run your video productions: switcher control, macros, audio, media, editing palettes, recording and streaming. MixEffect then turns the dial past ten with animated SuperSource transitions, Video Follows Audio, customizable layouts, and Shortcuts support.
Manage your live productions confidently with MixEffect!
# PRICING
MixEffect is a free download from the App Store.
Features are limited to creating new switcher connection and streaming service entries, Program/Preview, Fader Bar control, and running the ATEM Simulator. 
Want more? Try out MixEffect Pro over a generous 30 day period. MixEffect Pro brings full switcher control, SuperSource, Video Follows Audio, macro organization, streaming, recording, editing palettes, custom layouts, and much more!
A single In-App purchase unlocks MixEffect Pro -- no subscriptions, ads, or hidden fees.
# FEATURES
MixEffect is packed full of features to control your ATEM switchers.
## SWITCHER MANAGEMENT
Control multiple ATEM switchers. Sync your switcher settings between all of your iCloud-connected devices. 
## PANELS / BUTTONS
Customize the look of your switcher interface with separate iPhone, Landscape, and iPad-optimized layouts. Choose from 20 panels to include in your layouts.
## SUPERSOURCE
Become a SuperSource master on your ATEM Mini Extreme and Mini Extreme ISO. Automatically animate transitions when switching between SuperSource layouts! Use drag and drop to rearrange your boxes. Save your favorite preset layouts and share them with others.
## AUDIO
Control audio on ATEM switchers. Adjust each audio source’s input gain, fader gain, frames delay, and pan settings.
## MACROS
Give your macros the gift of icons, colors, filtering, and sorting. Choose from three different display layouts: Grid, Buttons, and List. Access all of your macros from the virtual switcher interface.
## MEDIA
Upload still images from your Photo Library into your switcher’s Media Pool.
## TRANSITIONS
Access all the transitions supported by your switcher such as Mix, Dip, Wipe, and DVE, not just the ones wired to hardware buttons.
## DOWNSTREAM KEYERS
Missing that DSK On Air button on your ATEM Mini? It's there in MixEffect!
## UPSTREAM KEYERS
Adjust your Luma, Chroma, Pattern, and DVE settings for your upstream keyers. Use touch to easily set the chroma sample and change the position of your DVE frame.
## AUTOMATIONS
Control your ATEM switcher with your voice and Shortcuts. Automatically switch inputs, change SuperSource layouts, and run macros when your audio levels rise or fall below a certain threshold. Enjoy extensive keyboard shortcuts throughout the app.
## COLOR GENERATORS
Change your color sources without having to dig through palettes.
## HYPERDECK
Control up to four HyperDecks from MixEffect.
## AUX
Set the sources for all of your auxiliary outputs.
## STREAMING
Add streaming services, servers, and profiles without having to know XML. Set a default profile and server for each of your streaming services. Import and export the Streaming.xml files supported by the ATEM Mini Pro, Pro ISO, Mini Extreme, and Mini Extreme ISO line of switchers. 
## RECORDING
Control your disk recordings from your iPhone or iPad. Switch disks with a tap and see how much time is available for recording.
## SECURITY
Prevent unwanted access to MixEffect with Face ID (or device passcode lock). Activate View Only Mode so people can see what’s happening on the switcher without the ability to change anything.
## SWITCHER SETTINGS
Set your switcher’s video mode, change the labels of sources, configure Multiview, and save your switcher's startup settings.
## SIMULATOR
MixEffect features a simulated ATEM 1 M/E Production 4K switcher for testing purposes.

bluejetty:00144085:ios.description:
Take full control of your business right from your phone with Jarbas. 
Sell more, organize your orders, manage inventory, credit sales and finances all in one place with a simple, practical system made for small businesses.
With Jarbas, you sell online and in person, using your phone or a web browser through the web version, track everything in real time and never miss a sale, even without an internet connection.
Main features:
• Customer Management
Organize your customers with a profile including photo, contact information and address, and keep a complete purchase history. Import directly from your phone in seconds.
• Product Management
Register products with name, barcode, price, expiration date and quantity. Organize them by categories and subcategories with color tags. Fully integrated with inventory control.
• Inventory Control
Track product entries and exits and receive real-time low-stock alerts. Automatically synced across all your devices.
• Order Management
Create orders at the counter or online. Place orders yourself or use a link or QR Code so customers can order from their smartphones. Track orders by status such as open, confirmed, paid, in production or completed and keep customers informed.
• POS System (Point of Sale)
Manage all your sales in one place, online or offline. Handle in-store, online and card terminal sales with ease. Scan products using barcodes and print orders directly from the app.
• Quotes and Estimates
Create service proposals, send them directly to customers and turn estimates into sales with just a few clicks.
• Online Catalog and Virtual Showcase
Build a complete, customized product catalog with photos, prices and descriptions and share it with your customers.
• Digital Menu
Customize your menu with a professional look and receive orders directly through it, with no registration required and no sales commissions.
• Sell on Social Media
Sell directly through WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and Google, all integrated with your order and inventory management.
• Credit Sales
Sell on credit with full control over installments, due dates and amounts per customer. Organize collection routes efficiently.
• Financial Management
Track expenses, income, accounts payable and receivable in one place, with clear charts and reports.
• Reports and Analytics
View revenue, best-selling products, cash flow and business performance in real time from your phone.
• Multi-User Access Control
Add team members and manage access permissions for each one.
• Web Version
In addition to the mobile app, manage your business on a computer using the web version.
Jarbas App is made for:
• Microentrepreneurs and small businesses
• Convenience stores and grocery shops
• Clothing, cosmetics, gift and variety stores
• Jewelry, fashion jewelry and pet shops
• Restaurants, snack bars and food trucks
• Cafés, candy stores and ice cream shops
• Bakeries, bars and distributors
• Service providers and freelancers
Why choose Jarbas?
• Easy to use, even without tech experience
• Works online and offline, on mobile or desktop
• Everything in one place: sales, inventory and finance
• Saves time and reduces mistakes
• Built for everyday business management
Download Jarbas now and discover how simple it is to sell and manage your business efficiently.

bluejetty:00026975:ios.description:

Start your 7-day free trial to unlock all features.
SCAM & CALL PROTECTION
Scammers use fake calls, texts, malicious links, and websites to imitate banks, delivery services, retailers, and other trusted brands. 
Alongside robocall filtering, Malwarebytes helps protect against:
- Suspicious text scams and phishing attempts
- Malicious links and unsafe websites
- Brand impersonation and social engineering attacks
- Annoying spam calls
SAFER BROWSING & AD BLOCKER
Web Protection: Blocks phishing sites and risky links before you enter payment or personal data.
Ad blocking: Reduce intrusive ads and trackers while browsing.
FAST VPN FOR PRIVATE BROWSING 
Incognito alone does not hide all of your online activity. Malwarebytes VPN helps protect your privacy on public Wi-Fi or while traveling.
Encrypt your internet connection for added privacy
Shield your IP address from trackers and advertisers
Browse more safely on public Wi-Fi
IDENTITY THEFT PROTECTION
Your email addresses, passwords, and personal information may be exposed in data breaches without you knowing.
Digital Footprint Scanner: Run an email scan and check where your personal information may have been leaked.
Data breach insights: See where your information may have been exposed and review steps to help secure affected accounts.
24/7 monitoring: Get real-time support and up to $2 million in identity theft insurance
WHY CHOOSE MALWAREBYTES?
- Mobile security against scams, spam calls, sketchy websites, and more privacy risks.
- Built by Malwarebytes, with 17+ years as a trusted name in antivirus and cybersecurity.
- Secure VPN and digital footprint tools for added privacy
- Simple protection without complicated setup
- No third-party ads in the Malwarebytes app
- 4 million daily threats blocked
Malwarebytes for iOS FAQs:
- Can Malwarebytes help protect my iPhone from scam texts and phishing links?
Malwarebytes helps detect suspicious text scams, phishing attempts, malicious links, and brand impersonation.
- Can Malwarebytes protect me on public Wi-Fi?
Malwarebytes VPN encrypts your internet connection, protects your privacy on public Wi-Fi, and alerts you to turn on VPN whenever you join an unsecure network.
- Can Malwarebytes check whether my information was exposed in a data breach?
The Digital Footprint Scanner checks your email against known data breaches and shows you how to secure your accounts.
- Does Malwarebytes scan iPhones for viruses?
Because of iOS platform restrictions, Malwarebytes does not perform traditional malware-file scans on iPhone. Instead, it focuses on proactive protection against phishing sites, scam texts, spam calls, malicious links, and unsafe websites.
TRIAL & DEVICE INFORMATION
7-day free trial: Unlock device protection features during the trial (Identity Theft Protection not included). Premium features require a subscription after the trial unless canceled. Manage your subscription in Apple ID settings.
Family Sharing: Premium subscription features are not eligible for Family Sharing.
Compatible with iOS 18 or later with an active internet connection. iPad users can benefit from Web Protection (Premium) and Ad Blocking (Included) for safer Safari browsing.
Identity Protection features vary by region.

bluejetty:00160633:ios.description:
Greetings from My Calendar – a simple but stylish period tracker for girls and women.
With the support of this accurate period tracker, you can easily track period phases, and get notified before periods arrive. Pinpointing your ovulation day and fertile windows can never be easier. Learning about PMS symptoms, or monitoring hormone health – this all-in-one period calendar app can satisfy all your needs.
Your well-being is important, and your menstrual journey is unique. As we value that, we have designed a variety of exquisite themes. Soothing watercolor styles, harmonious gradient colors, elegant flowery decorations, and more – You can change it at any time to suit your unique taste.
Your Data, Your Choice. Our app allows you to use it without the need for registration or login. All your data is stored locally. Set an app lock and protect your privacy from inquisitive stares. Your data security is always our top priority.
Key Features:
Period and Ovulation Prediction and Reminders
- Use the menstrual tracker to record past cycles to understand your own patterns.
- Spot the timing of ovulation and your most fertile days for better family planning or period tracker birth control needs.
- Customize reminder dates, times, and frequencies and receive future predictions.
- Plan your life, work, and social activities accordingly for a more carefree lifestyle.
PMS Symptoms and Daily Wellness Metrics
- Log and track different symptoms and moods in the menstrual calendar with a built-in period mood tracker.
- Gain insights into your body and emotional states and focus more on overall health.
- Keep a menstrual diary as a health record that can be shared with healthcare providers.
- Cultivate healthy lifestyle habits like regular weigh-ins and adequate water intake.
Menstrual Cycle Trend Analysis
- Track changes in cycle length and period durations in the cycle history.
- Explore your patterns of period flow and symptoms in intuitive charts and reports.
- Scientifically adjust your lifestyle based on intelligent analysis results.
- Also works perfectly as an irregular period tracker, helping you identify trends even with unpredictable cycles.
Customizable Themes
- Choose from a diverse theme library based on your personal preferences.
- Switch application interfaces to enjoy a fresh and pleasant user experience.
Data Security & Privacy
- Start using the application instantly without requiring account registration.
- Store all the data on your local device.
- Set a PIN to further enhance data security.
- Transfer and restore data easily to prevent data loss.
My Calendar is your trusted companion to guide you through each phase of life with confidence and convenience – from menstruacion to period tracker menopause.
Download today and empower yourself with the best period tracker experience – one that’s not only simple and secure, but perfect for period tracker girls and even a period tracker for kids if needed.

The metronome app you have been waiting for.
As a musician, you know the importance of the tempo. That's why Metronome Pro has been created, so you don’t lose the pace and play with a perfect precision! Always keep the tempo and rhythm, wherever you are.
This metronome has been made by professional musicians: its extremely accurate system will perfectly help you to get the right tempo, whatever the instrument you use. Metronome Pro works great for daily practice, live performances with your band or if you do records in a studio.
Intuitive to use with a beautiful interface, it offers many ways to personalize your experience. The possibilities are almost infinite: The BPM beats per minute can be set on a wheel, from 30 to 250 beats. It can also be set manually with the Tap BPM feature. Finally, Time Signature and Subdvisions can also be changed to fit your specific needs.

bluejetty:00175615:ios.description:
With Pocket Yoga you can keep up with your practice at your own pace in the comforts of your own home. Simply roll out your mat, place your device in front, and Pocket Yoga will guide you through your entire session. 
Choose between 27 different sessions of varying duration and difficulty. Learn the poses with the pose dictionary containing detailed explanations of the correct posture, alignment, and benefits.
Features:
• Soothing, detailed voice and visual instruction guides you through every pose.
• Expertly designed practices by experienced yoga instructors.
• Over 500 beautifully illustrated pose images show correct posture and alignment.
• Dictionary of poses contains the descriptions and benefits of each pose.
• Play music from your music library, Apple Music, or Spotify as an alternative to the default music in the app.
• Quickly preview a practice to see if it is right for you before you start.
• Unlock new environments as you progress in your yoga journey.
• Track your progress with an ongoing log of all your yoga practices.
• Accounts sync environments and progress across devices.
• Play the practices on your Apple TV through AirPlay.
• Integrates with the Health app. Track your workouts, heart rate, and calories burned.
Accolades:
‣ Listed among the “15 Best Beauty Apps” - InStyle
‣ Selected by CNN as one of the "10 great mobile health apps"
‣ Featured by Apple in "Get in Shape", "Let's Get Moving", "10 Essentials" and "New and Noteworthy"
APPLE WATCH
Pocket Yoga works great on your Apple Watch. When you are playing a practice on your iPhone you can get extra information directly on your wrist. See the current pose, time remaining, heart rate, calories burned, and much more. You can even control your practice directly from your Apple Watch.
WIDGET
The “Pose of the Day” Widget helps you learn the names of the poses by showing you a different pose each day. You can see the name of the daily pose in English, Sanskrit and even in Devanagari script. Also tap on the pose image to launch Pocket Yoga and go directly to that pose.

bluejetty:00155933:ios.summary: Information about your health should be right at your fingertips. Leon Medical Centers’ state-of-the-art technology makes accessing your health record easy and secure. We have the latest electronic health record system that seamlessly conne
bluejetty:00155933:ios.description:
Information about your health should be right at your fingertips. Leon Medical Centers’ state-of-the-art technology makes accessing your health record easy and secure. We have the latest electronic health record system that seamlessly connects you to all of our medical staff.
Free, Secure Access to Your Electronic Health Record
You can always see your electronic health record on MyLeon. It’s a free online system that every patient can use at Leon Medical Centers. It puts all of your health history in one place, where it’s safely stored and can’t be accessed by anyone but you and your healthcare providers.
Your Health Record Travels With You
Since our system is built on Epic’s state-of-the art electronic health record software, it’s easy for us to securely share your information with other hospitals or doctors if needed. You can travel to other cities, states and countries knowing your health record travels with you. Doctors and hospitals throughout the U.S. and around the world who use this system can access your medical record if you need care when you’re away from home.
Easy Sign-Up Process
It’s easy to get started. During your first doctor’s visit, you’ll get an activation code to sign up for MyLeon. If you forget or lose the code, you can still sign up by going to the website and answering a few questions about yourself. Remember, we’re always here to help you sign up and to answer your questions.
There’s a lot you can do on MyLeon, including:
• See your labs and other test results.
• See all of your medicines.
• Ask for refills of your medicines.
• Send messages to doctors, pharmacists and other staff.
• Ask questions.
• See a summary of your visits.
• Get health reminders.
• Schedule an appointment.
• Have a video call with a doctor.
• Upload health and fitness data, including data from the Apple Health app, when enrolled in self-tracking programs
Share Your Health Record With Loved Ones
We understand your loved ones want to be involved in your care. You can give your caregiver, family member or trusted friend access to your account on MyLeon. You just fill out a paper form that says you want someone else to see your electronic health record.

bluejetty:00126912:ios.description:
Just Run is a simple workout app to help you get running. I made this app to get myself off the couch and start running to get to 5K. Stick to the workout plan, and you'll be able to run 5K in 9 weeks. It really does work!
If you're already able to run 5K, Just Run also has a 6-week plan to help you get up to 10K!
WORKOUT PLANS:
 - Zero to 5K: Gets you from absolute zero running experience to 5K in just 9 weeks, with three 30-minute workouts per week
 - 5K to 10K: If you can already run 5K, or have finished Zero to 5K, this plan gets you to 10K in only 6 weeks
FEATURES:
- Target dates for each workout, calculated based on your progress, and optimal exercise days
- Choose from multiple trainer voices, which tell you exactly when to run and walk
- No ads! Ads are no fun, so Just Run has no ads!
- Works with music, audiobook and podcast apps - Just Run will briefly lower the volume of the other app when prompting you to run and walk, so you'll never miss a prompt
- Runs in the background. Turn off your screen, or switch to another app, and you'll still hear the run and walk prompts
- Upgrade to Premium to get more trainer voices, multiple theme options, and to support continued development of Just Run
I'd love to hear how you're getting on with Just Run. You can email me at run@jupli.com.

bluejetty:00068472:ios.description:
Naik kelas bukan berarti Anda harus jadi analis profesional, hafal semua rasio keuangan, atau paham setiap indikator teknikal sebelum berani mulai. Naik kelas berarti memahami kerumitan pasar dan mengubahnya menjadi market clarity — dengan bantuan AI yang bekerja di belakang layar, sementara keputusan akhir tetap sepenuhnya di tangan Anda.
5 PILAR IPOT X
- Think Smarter — AI membantu menganalisa dan menginterpretasi data pasar, bukan menggantikan penilaian Anda
- See Deeper — baca kondisi pasar sampai ke lapisan yang tidak terlihat kasat mata, termasuk arus dana dan smart money
- Read Clearly — data screening, flow, dan teknikal disederhanakan menjadi pembacaan yang jelas, bukan disamarkan
- Discover, Monitor & Compare — temukan kandidat saham, pantau, dan bandingkan dalam satu tempat
- Move Effortlessly — dari analisis ke eksekusi tanpa loncat-loncat platform
8 EKOSISTEM AI YANG BEKERJA SEBAGAI SATU SISTEM KECERDASAN
- AI Screener Multi-Bahasa — cari kandidat saham cukup dengan bahasa sehari-hari, didukung lebih dari 1.100 metrik
- AI Stock Comparison — bandingkan hingga 5 saham berdampingan berdasarkan bukti, bukan sekadar ingatan atau impresi
- UI/UX Real Time — menyatukan seluruh fitur AI dalam satu alur yang intuitif dan mulus
- AI Inferencing — mengecek-silang sinyal harga, volume, trade flow, smart money, hingga fundamental secara sistemik
- AI Interpretation Engine — mensintesis ribuan observasi pasar menjadi satu pembacaan yang koheren dan relevan
- Pattern Recognition — memvalidasi pola teknikal lewat konvergensi sinyal, bukan sekadar ramalan
- AI Technical Radar — memindai seluruh pasar sekali jalan untuk menemukan setup teknikal yang relevan
- AI Trade Flow — membaca arah uang lewat Smart Money, aktivitas asing, dan tingkat agresivitas transaksi, dengan histori hingga 10 tahun
PRINSIP YANG TIDAK BERUBAH
AI mengolah data. AI membantu analisis dan interpretasi. Tapi keputusan untuk membeli, menjual, atau menahan tetap sepenuhnya di tangan Anda. IPOT X tidak menjanjikan bahwa setiap keputusan akan benar — tidak ada teknologi yang bisa menjanjikan itu. IPOT X hanya memastikan Anda membuat keputusan dengan lebih banyak kejelasan dan lebih sedikit kerumitan.
DIDUKUNG INFRASTRUKTUR INSTITUSI
IPOT X dikembangkan oleh PT Indo Premier Sekuritas, salah satu sekuritas terbesar di Indonesia dengan aset investasi nasabah mencapai Rp312 triliun, terdepan dalam pengembangan AI Big Data, AI Inferencing, dan ekosistem AI Trading yang terintegrasi.
Dari screening sampai eksekusi, satu alur, presisi bukan tebakan.
IPOT X. Act Like Smart Money.
---

bluejetty:00134167:ios.description:

- Create or join a password-protected private room

- Pool Checkers
- Portuguese Checkers

- Brazilian Checkers
- Czech Checkers
- Russian Checkers
- Turkish Checkers
- Thai Checkers
- Malaysian Checkers
Make the game yours
- Switch between 2D and 3D checkerboard views
- Choose from eight board themes
- Enjoy smooth animations, sounds, and visual effects
- Read the rules for every supported variant
- Play on phones, tablets, and wide screens
Whether you call it checkers or draughts, choose the match that suits you: online, against the computer, or with a friend nearby.

bluejetty:00128627:ios.description:
Install best Wifi password network tool.
So many features
* Check wifi information
* Router your router admin password
* Search your modem very fast
* Check your IP information
* Generate Random password for any security.
* Check your Internet download speed & upload speed (very accurate).
* Check ping latency.
* Save all Internet Speed test with every information.
* Check offline any time Internet speed test information.
* Check details of every speed test you have made before.
* Delete any speed test with a single click
* Right now available in 3 languages: English, Spanish & Portuguese
* Scan QR code to connect Wi-Fi
* Generate Wi-Fi Qr codes
* Ping to any IP or URL
* Share QR code with your friends to
* Check device information
NEW ADVANCED WIFI & NETWORK DIAGNOSTIC TOOLS
* Now also available in French (4 in-app languages: English, Spanish, French & Portuguese).
* Free Wi-Fi Hotspot Map & Finder: Locate public Wi-Fi networks, cafes, and free internet access points near you or anywhere in the world.
* Who's on My Wi-Fi (LAN Device Scanner): Scan your local Wi-Fi network in seconds to see every connected device, IP address, MAC vendor, and identify unauthorized users slowing down your internet.
* Hidden Spy Camera Detector & Privacy Scanner: Protect your privacy when traveling. Scan the local network for hidden IP cameras (RTSP/ONVIF), use the magnetic field detector for concealed electronics, and use the optical lens finder to spot infrared camera reflections.
* Wi-Fi Signal Strength Meter (dBm): Track live wireless signal stability and connection quality in real time as you move around your home or office.
* Wi-Fi Channel Analyzer (2.4 GHz & 5 GHz): Visualize overlapping wireless channels, avoid network interference, and choose the best channel for your router.
* Wi-Fi Coverage Mapper & Dead Zone Finder: Create a room-by-room Wi-Fi coverage heatmap to find weak signal spots and optimize router or mesh placement.
* Bufferbloat & Gaming Latency Test: Test how your internet connection performs under heavy download and upload loads to diagnose lag spikes during gaming, streaming, and video conferencing.
* DNS Speed Test & Benchmark: Compare response times across leading public DNS providers including Cloudflare, Google DNS, Quad9, and OpenDNS.
* Network Security Audit & Rogue AP Check: Inspect your Wi-Fi encryption protocol, detect insecure networks, evil-twin hotspots, and DNS hijacking risks.
* Encrypted Wi-Fi Password Vault: Securely organize and back up your own Wi-Fi network credentials on your device with biometric protection.
* Router Default Password Lookup & Admin Setup: Quickly find default login usernames and passwords for hundreds of router and modem brands, and access your 192.168.1.1 or 192.168.0.1 router configuration page.
* Wake-on-LAN (WoL): Send magic packets to wake up your PC, Mac, or NAS server remotely over your network.
* Home Screen Widget: View your live connection status, IP address, and last speed test directly from your iOS Home Screen.
!!! IMPORTANT PLEASE READ IT !!!
This app is not for cracking or hacking any kind of wifi so if it happens it will simply a coincidence. It simply generates random password with lots of other features.
Enjoy it.

"The app is very user friendly, easy to use and is full
bluejetty:00060852:ios.description:
Separate budget files for any purpose: personal finance, family budget or company accounting. Versions for all platforms with cloud sync.
Elegant, super easy home accounting software.
"The app is very user friendly, easy to use and is full of functions that covers almost all needs for making and following personal budget. Great! 10 out of 10!" - Guntars Kaneps
Track family budget with fantastic ease!
The features which make this personal accounting software unique in its category are total simplicity and clearness. You can see at once from the summary view the way your money was spent, total sum and percentage structure for categories, balance on accounts, as well as overall balance.
Key features:
• Sync data across multiple devices and PC
Several users can work with a single database and sync changes over the Internet. Alzex Finance is integrated with Files app: you can use virtually any cloud service (or SMB, FTP, WebDAV, etc) to share your budget with your family or colleagues. Instruction: https://community.alzex.com/knowledge-base/article/sync_ios
• Entering recurring data with a single click
You can enter recurring transactions very quickly, simply type first few letters and select a transaction from the list of frequently used transactions, and then the program fills data to all fields of the form.
• Currencies
The program supports an unlimited number of currencies, cryptocurrencies and precious metals. Also you can add your own currencies, including "virtual" ones, i.e. you can keep track of money and other things (metals, petrol, units of measurement). Exchange rates can be downloaded from the Internet.
• Accounts
This is the main way of separating transactions in the program. You can create any number of accounts, such as credit cards, bank accounts, cash, electronic money, etc.
• Scheduler
The scheduler lets you create recurring transactions automatically. These transactions will be created automatically, without any user intervention, or with his confirmation, if needed.
• Reports
Reports help you to analyze your financial situation. It will help you to understand where your money is going and manage your income in the most efficient way.
• Budget
The program makes it easy to monitor progress in achieving your financial goals and control expenses.
Paid subscription is required. Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
Privacy policy: www.alzex.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of service: https://www.alzex.com/terms-of-service.html
Contacts:

http://community.alzex.com
Your feedback is important to us in order to get an idea of how to make Alzex Finance software a better product for you. If you have a good idea of a new feature, or a better way of doing something, please drop us a note.
Technical support is provided by email. You can contact us at support@alzex.com.

bluejetty:00186148:ios.description:
The Talmud Yerushalmi texts and Jewish commentaries are provided in Hebrew and English (some Sederem not translated yet to English). 
Clicking on the text directs to a page with commentaries, translations and more biblical sources.
The Jerusalem Talmud (Hebrew: תַּלְמוּד יְרוּשַׁלְמִי‬, Talmud Yerushalmi, often Yerushalmi for short), also known as the Palestinian Talmud or Talmuda de-Eretz Yisrael (Talmud of the Land of Israel), is a collection of Rabbinic notes on the second-century Jewish oral tradition known as the Mishnah. Naming this version of the Talmud after the Land of Israel rather than Jerusalem is considered more accurate by some because, while the work was certainly composed in "the West" (as seen from Babylonia), i.e. in the Holy Land, it mainly originates from the Galilee rather than from Jerusalem in Judea, as no Jews lived in Jerusalem at this time.[1][2] The Jerusalem Talmud was compiled in the Land of Israel, then divided between the Byzantine provinces of Palaestina Prima and Palaestina Secunda, and was brought to an end sometime around 400.[citation needed] The Jerusalem Talmud predates its counterpart, the Babylonian Talmud (known in Hebrew as the Talmud Bavli), by about 200 years,[citation needed] and is written in both Hebrew and Jewish Palestinian Aramaic. bluejetty:00073745:ios.name: Tube Map - London Underground
bluejetty:00073745:ios.summary: Tube Map is a trusted navigation app for travelling across London. Built around the TfL London Underground map design, Tube Map helps commuters, tourists, and daily travellers plan routes, check live service information, and move around the
bluejetty:00073745:ios.description:
Tube Map is a trusted navigation app for travelling across London. Built around the TfL London Underground map design, Tube Map helps commuters, tourists, and daily travellers plan routes, check live service information, and move around the city with more confidence.
Tube Map includes the iconic TfL Tube map design, based on the famous Harry Beck layout. The map is easy to read, simple to explore, and designed to help you understand London Underground connections quickly.
The app also includes additional map views for the Night Tube and Rail Network, plus a more geographical map view created to help you understand station locations and routes across the city.
Key Features:
- TfL London Underground map design
- Works online and offline
- Journey planner with step-by-step directions
- Real-time routing around delays and closures
- Live line status for delays, closures, and service changes
- Live Tube departures from TfL
- National Rail arrivals and departures
- Night Tube and Rail Network map views
- Find the nearest Tube station in London
- Save favourite routes for quick access
- Save Home and Work stations
- Line status widget
- Travel guide for London journeys
- Apple Watch app support
- Premium features for extra travel tools
Journey Planning Made Easy
Plan journeys across London with a simple route planner that works with or without an internet connection. Tube Map helps you choose routes, follow step-by-step directions, and travel more easily through the London Underground network.
Live Travel Updates
Stay informed with live Tube departures, line status information, and station updates. Check if a line is delayed, closed, or running with service changes before you travel.
Tube Map also supports National Rail arrivals and departures, giving you more useful information when your journey includes rail connections.
Premium Features
Tube Map Premium available as an in-app subscription: 99p weekly, £3.99 monthly or £9.99 annually, or as a one-off purchase of £24.99. Prices may vary by location. Cancel at any time, for any reason. Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, at the cost of your chosen price tier. Subscriptions can be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings in your iTunes Account. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased, where applicable.
Please Note
Line Status notifications are provided to support your journey, but delivery cannot be guaranteed at all times. Some features may depend on data availability and technical conditions. Continued use of GPS in the background can decrease battery life.
Privacy Policy: https://mapway.ai/londontubeios/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://mapway.ai/londontubeios/terms/

bluejetty:00131268:ios.summary: Imagine you woke up to the apocalypse in the survival shooter Last Day on Earth. Feel the horror and adrenaline rush from the process of real surviving in a harsh environment! Meet the world where zombie hordes' instinct to murder you is as
bluejetty:00131268:ios.description:
Imagine you woke up to the apocalypse in the survival shooter Last Day on Earth. Feel the horror and adrenaline rush from the process of real surviving in a harsh environment! Meet the world where zombie hordes' instinct to murder you is as strong as thirst or hunger. Descend into the atmosphere of survival right now or start Last Day on Earth once you're done with reading this description, in which I'm going to tell you about some key features.
■ Create your character and look around: near your shelter, there are a lot of locations with different danger levels. From the resources collected here you can craft everything necessary for survival: from a house and clothes to weapons and an all-terrain vehicle.
■ As your level grows, hundreds of useful recipes and blueprints will become available to you. First off, build and enhance the walls of your house, learn new skills, modify weapons, and discover all the joys of the gaming process.
■ Pets are an islet of love and friendship in the world of the zombie apocalypse. Joyful huskies and smart shepherd dogs will be happy to accompany you in raids, and while you're about it, help you carry out loot from hard-to-reach places.
■ Assemble a fast Chopper, an ATV, or a motorboat and get access to remote locations on the map. You don't get the rarest resources for complex blueprints and unique quests for nothing. If there's a mechanic sleeping inside of you, it's just the time to wake him up!
■ If you like cooperative play, visit the city in the Crater. There you'll meet loyal companions and find out what you're worth in PvP. Join a clan, play with other players, feel the unity of a real pack! 
■ Survivor (if you're reading this, it means I can still call you that), you have access to an arsenal of cold weapons and firearms that even a seasoned hardcore player would envy: baseball bats, shotguns, rifles, a good old assault rifle, mortars, and explosives. The list is endless, and it's better for you to see it with your own eyes.
■ Forests, Police Station, Spooky Farm, Port, and Bunkers packed with zombies, raiders, and other random characters. Always be ready to use force or flee. Anything goes, when it comes to survival!
Now you are a survivor. No matter who you are, where you come from, and what you used to be before. Welcome to the cruel new world...

bluejetty:00147046:ios.description:
TRCBankmobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with TRCBankmobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the TRCBankmobile app, you must be enrolled as a Table Rock Community Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00027416:ios.name: Fuelio: MPG & Mileage Tracker
bluejetty:00027416:ios.summary: Fuelio is a simple, easy-to-use fuel tracker for your mileage, fuel consumption, and car expenses. Just log your odometer reading and how much fuel you bought at each fill-up, and Fuelio calculates your fuel economy and keeps a full fuel lo
bluejetty:00027416:ios.description:
Fuelio is a simple, easy-to-use fuel tracker for your mileage, fuel consumption, and car expenses. Just log your odometer reading and how much fuel you bought at each fill-up, and Fuelio calculates your fuel economy and keeps a full fuel log, with clear charts and statistics for one car or a small fleet.
Find nearby gas stations and compare gas prices right from CarPlay, so you always know where to refuel for less. Glance at your dashboard from a Home Screen widget, or report a missing or incorrect gas station from the app.
Generate a Seller's report or a Custom report in a few taps, handy when selling a car or filing an expense claim.
Fuelio Premium turns Fuelio into a complete expense tracker for your car, covering maintenance, insurance, repairs, parking, tolls, car washes, and more. It also unlocks maintenance reminders, camera receipt scanning that works instantly on your device, even offline, weather logging on fill-ups, and three deeper report types: Annual Summary, Fuel Efficiency, and Maintenance.
Supports every major fuel type — Gasoline, Diesel, Electric, LPG, CNG, Ethanol — including bi-fuel vehicles with two tanks. Distance, volume, and consumption units are available for every region.
Add as many vehicles as you want, each with its own units, and import or export your data as CSV any time.
Your data stays on your device, with optional automatic iCloud Drive backup. No account required, no ads.
Fuel prices are provided by users and third-party sources (or official government providers in some countries) and may not reflect current station rates. We are not responsible for their accuracy or availability.
Terms of use: https://fuel.io/termsofuse.html

Multiplayer Bid Whist and Spades Card Game:
Play Bid Whist for free or dive into thrilling Spades card game battles with friends or random opponents. Team up, compete in 2v2 matches, or go solo — the choice is yours in these real-time multiplayer card game modes. Experience smooth gameplay, classic design, and a modern touch that keeps every hand exciting!

Compete in thrilling online Spades game tournaments where players from around the world face off for glory! Win matches to collect stars and unlock new cities and states as you climb through the ranks. Each city brings new challenges, bigger rewards, and tougher opponents. Whether you’re aiming to become the Bid Whist game champion or dominate in Spades online, every victory counts!
Totally Free to Play:
Enjoy unlimited rounds of Bid Whist for free and Spades games free without restrictions! No hidden fees — just pure, non-stop card fun. Whether you prefer the competitive thrill of Spades online or the strategic depth of the Bid Whist game, everything is available to play free.

-Complete quests, achievements, and tournaments to earn more Coins.
-Watch short videos and get up to 1,000,000 free coins instantly — no tricks, just rewards!
Enjoy endless playtime while you climb the ranks in your favorite Spades online and Bid Whist game.
WHY YOU’LL LOVE SPADES BID WHIST CARD GAMES:
-Combines Bid Whist and Spades card game in one powerful app
-Real-time multiplayer card game with worldwide players
-Smooth, classic design with intuitive controls
-Daily tournaments, rewards, and challenges

Download Spades Bid Whist: Card Games today and experience the next level of classic card gaming!

bluejetty:00148570:ios.name: BioID Facial Recognition
bluejetty:00148570:ios.summary: The BioID app is a multifactor user authenticator – see how well face recognition works today! Developers and companies can easily add biometric authentication to their mobile platforms with a few lines of code. Their end users can log in o
bluejetty:00148570:ios.description:
The BioID app is a multifactor user authenticator – see how well face recognition works today! Developers and companies can easily add biometric authentication to their mobile platforms with a few lines of code. Their end users can log in or authorize transactions securely and conveniently. Forget passwords. Be recognized.
EASY MULTIFACTOR AUTHENTICATION WITH MOBILE FACE RECOGNITION
WHY BIOMETRICS?
Password hacks make headlines almost every week: a password alone is not secure enough. And typing a long, complicated password on a mobile device is difficult and annoying. Multifactor authentication systems using factors like software/hardware tokens or biometric security are becoming more common. 
Biometric authentication such as facial recognition verifies the physical presence of the user, for easy, strong multifactor authentication using only the user’s mobile device with no extra hardware needed. 
WHAT DOES THE APP DO FOR ME?
The BioID app provides multifactor user authentication (biometrics + mobile device). It is a mobile client for BioID Connect, an identity service based on our BioID Web Service (BWS) – the original 'biometric as a service' with our patented 'fake defender' liveness detection – and supporting OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0.
• End users can use it as a mobile authenticator to log in to any apps and websites that support the app (including our BWS developer portal).
• Developers and companies can easily add secure, convenient face recognition to their mobile platform (websites or native apps), without any knowledge of biometrics.
• Anyone can try out our biometric technology and see how well state-of-the-art face recognition works.
The app currently supports liveness detection against photo attacks, and challenge-response to prevent video replay attacks.
PROTECT YOUR EMPLOYEES
As an administrator, improve the security of your authentication simply by supporting BioID Connect through industry standard OpenID Connect / OAuth 2.0 protocols.
PROTECT YOUR USERS
As a developer, enhance app or website security with just a few lines of code by supporting BioID Connect. We take care of all the biometrics and the associated user interface; you get instant biometric security. 
PROTECT YOURSELF
As a user, get simple and user-friendly stronger security for the growing number of apps and websites that support BioID Connect.

bluejetty:00096272:ios.description:
Drive, shoot, chase, and smash your way through Police vs Gangster: Crime City, the ultimate open-world action simulator packed with mafia warfare, daring heists, and thrilling police chases!
Explore a massive open world filled with intense car chases, and challenging missions. Whether you’re leading your gang in victory, hunting down rivals, or escaping the law, every decision shapes your rise to power.
Become a Gangster Legend!
Play as an armed gangster in a realistic 3D city.
Equip your arsenal: pistols, shotguns, SMGs, assault rifles, sniper rifles, bazookas, grenades, and more.
Control over 60 vehicles like cars, helicopters, airplanes, and boats.
You can steal any vehicle (car, airplane, copter, boat) you see on the map! Time for some carjacking.
Unlock 20+ weapons and 60+ vehicles to dominate the streets.
Rank up from Bronze to Master through dangerous missions, thanks to the free Rank Pass.
Missions to accomplish in this game:
1- Steal your first car and escape the cop
2- Stop the rival gang's car and disarmedthe 2 gangsters
3- Get rid of the stolen car. Escape the police and blow up the car with a rocket launcher
4- Steal a helicopter by disarming all the guards
5- Fly the helicopter to the rendezvous point, passing through the checkpoints
6- Use the helicopter to grab a cash transport truck and drive it back to our hideout
7- Pick up the VIP at the airport. Use a plane and pass through the checkpoints
8- Bring the VIP to the boss. Use a boat and go through the checkpoints
9- Protect the VIP from a rival gang. Disarm the waves of gangsters trying to break into our hideout
10- Disarmed the cops with sniper from a helicopter to help our gang escape the bank heist and robbery
11- Parachute from the helicopter to retrieve the cash on the ground
12- Use a plane to transport the stolen money. Stay under the radar, flying low to avoid detection
13- Go to the rival gang’s garage and destroy all their fancy cars with grenades
14- Steal the last car and drive over 200 km/h in the city
15- Steal a military helicopter and use it to launch rockets at moving police cars
16- Win a boat race to prove you're the best pilot on the water
17- Use the magnet chopper to steal a crate of uranium from the nuclear plant
18- It's time to disarm the rival boss: follow his helicopter using a small plane. Find his hideout
19- Before disarmed the final boss, train your aim at our shooting range
20- Go to the final boss's hideout, disarmed all the gangsters and the boss. You are now the city's new boss!
Features : 
- Real carjacking system, like in gta
- Character customization: choose male or female, with 60+ outfits.
- Go to the shop for guns, shooting training, and clothes.
- Smartphone system: accept missions, use GPS, teleport, and more.
- Full freedom: buy houses, garages, helipads, boat docks, even your own runway.
- Immersive world: dynamic day/night cycle, weather effects (rain, snow, thunderstorms), and realistic 3D clouds.
- Advanced systems: realistic flight physics, weapon mechanics, and explosive destruction.
- Unlimited free levels with non-stop action.
Police vs Gangster: Crime City Simulator is one of the most complete and exciting police vs gangster simulators ever made. Take control of the city, build your empire, and prove you’re the ultimate boss!

Control over 60 vehicles like cars, helicopters, airplanes, and boats.

Unlock 20+ weapons and 60+ vehicles to dominate the streets.

Rank up from Bronze to Master through dangerous missions, thanks to the free Rank Pass.

1- Steal your first car and escape the cop
2- Stop the rival gang's car and disarmedthe 2 gangsters
3- Get rid of the stolen car. Escape the police and blow up the car with a rocket launcher

4- Steal a helicopter by disarming all the guards
5- Fly the helicopter to the rendezvous point, passing through the checkpoints
6- Use the helicopter to grab a cash transport truck and drive it back to our hideout

7- Pick up the VIP at the airport. Use a plane and pass through the checkpoints
8- Bring the VIP to the boss. Use a boat and go through the checkpoints
9- Protect the VIP from a rival gang. Disarm the waves of gangsters trying to break into our hideout

10- Disarmed the cops with sniper from a helicopter to help our gang escape the bank heist and robbery
11- Parachute from the helicopter to retrieve the cash on the ground
12- Use a plane to transport the stolen money. Stay under the radar, flying low to avoid detection

13- Go to the rival gang’s garage and destroy all their fancy cars with grenades
14- Steal the last car and drive over 200 km/h in the city
15- Steal a military helicopter and use it to launch rockets at moving police cars
16- Win a boat race to prove you're the best pilot on the water
17- Use the magnet chopper to steal a crate of uranium from the nuclear plant

18- It's time to disarm the rival boss: follow his helicopter using a small plane. Find his hideout
19- Before disarmed the final boss, train your aim at our shooting range
20- Go to the final boss's hideout, disarmed all the gangsters and the boss. You are now the city's new boss!

bluejetty:00070451:ios.name: Lyric Studio - Rap Rhyme Maker
bluejetty:00070451:ios.summary:
Lyric Studio is a songwriting app for rappers and songwriters: write lyrics, find rhymes with AI, generate beats and record your song on the beat – all in one place. Start from a blank page or let AI write lyrics with you.
WRITE YOUR LYRIC
bluejetty:00070451:ios.description:
Lyric Studio is a songwriting app for rappers and songwriters: write lyrics, find rhymes with AI, generate beats and record your song on the beat – all in one place. Start from a blank page or let AI write lyrics with you.
WRITE YOUR LYRICS
• Lyric notepad – Start writing right away. Organize verses, hooks and full songs, and keep every idea saved in one place.
• AI rhyme finder – Stuck on a line? Get rhymes instantly from our AI-powered rhyming dictionary with 130K+ words, from perfect rhymes to multi-syllable rap rhymes.
• AI autocomplete – Lyric Studio reads the lyrics you have written so far and suggests the next line in your style and flow.
• AI lyric generator – Write lyrics from scratch with AI: pick a topic, a mood and a genre, and get a full verse or song to start from.
• Syllable counter – See the syllables of every line to keep your flow tight and your bars on beat.
MAKE THE BEAT
• AI beat generator – Create original beats in seconds for rap, hip hop, pop, R&B, reggae, country and more.
• Beat library – Choose from 100+ beats across genres and find the right vibe for your song.
RECORD YOUR SONG
• Rap recorder – Try your song by recording your voice over the beat. Hear how your verse sounds before you drop it.
• Freestyle practice – Load a beat and freestyle over it to find new flows and ideas.
SAVE AND SHARE
• All your creations are saved: lyrics, beats and recordings stay together, ready when inspiration hits.
• Share your songs on Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, iMessage and more.
• Multi-language support: write, rhyme and create in your own language.
WHO IT'S FOR
Rappers writing their next verse. Songwriters beating writer's block. Beginners learning how to write a song. Artists who want to record a quick demo on the go.
FAQ
• Can Lyric Studio write lyrics for me? Yes. The AI lyric generator writes verses and full songs from a topic, a mood and a genre, and you can edit every line.
• How does the AI rhyme finder work? Tap a word to get rhymes from a 130K+ word rhyming dictionary, including multi-syllable rhymes for rap.
• What is AI autocomplete? It reads the lyrics of your song and suggests the next line, so you keep the same flow and theme.
• Can I make beats? Yes. Generate beats with AI or pick one of 100+ beats for rap, hip hop, pop, R&B and more.
• Can I record my song? Yes. Record your voice over the beat to test your song and practice your flow.
• Does it count syllables? Yes. Every line shows its syllable count to help you stay on beat.
• Is it good for beginners? Yes. AI rhymes, autocomplete and the lyric generator help you write your first song step by step.
• Which languages are supported? Lyric Studio supports multiple languages, so you can write and rhyme in your own.
Questions or ideas? Write to us at support@bakeryscent.com
SUBSCRIPTION
Weekly, monthly and yearly plans renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings. Any unused free trial ends when you subscribe.
Privacy Policy: https://good-rhymes.web.app/policy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

ONLINE PVP GAMES

Amaze your crowd with cool shots to gain more followers and become more popular.

Plus, don't forget to join our community on Facebook and Instagram for some fun interactions with other players. And if you're up for a laugh, check out our Giphy for tons of entertainment!

See you on the lanes!

bluejetty:00043262:ios.description:
■ "Shopping List" solves these problems
- Automatically categorizes items, allowing you to efficiently navigate the store aisles
- Eliminates the hassle of revisiting the same aisles, helping you complete shopping in the shortest route
- Instantly converts lists sent by family or friends into a handy checklist with a simple copy and paste
【Key Features】
- Automatically organizes items by category based on product names for easy viewing
- Check off items effortlessly in a familiar reminder format
- Automatically formats pasted shopping lists into a user-friendly layout
- Weekend shopping reminder notifications prevent forgotten items
- "Create with AI": type a dish name or something like "tonight's dinner" and get a shopping list generated automatically (10 free trials)
【Scenarios where it shines】
＜A Reliable Partner for Busy Families＞
For parents juggling childcare and household chores, weekend shopping can be a daunting task. Especially when the family gathers, more shopping than usual is required. In such times, this app allows you to quickly add requests sent by family members, and the categorized list helps you shop efficiently in the store.
＜A strong ally for those living alone＞
For college students just starting to live alone, cooking for themselves is appealing but they may not know how to shop. By importing a list of recommended ingredients from their parents into the app, items are automatically organized by category, allowing smooth shopping without getting lost.
＜A Reliable Partner for Working Couples＞
For dual-income couples, both partners are often too busy with work to find time for shopping. With this app's sharing feature, if the wife sends a shopping list via email or social media, the husband can instantly import it into the app. Thanks to the automatically organized and easy-to-view list, they can efficiently shop during breaks from work and meet their family's requests.
【Shopping List Pro - One-time purchase】
With one purchase, enjoy a more comfortable shopping experience.
• Hide ads completely - use the app without interruptions
• Preset feature - open your frequently used lists with one tap
• Shopping history - quickly reuse what you bought last week
• Create with AI - generate up to 50 shopping lists per month
Payment will be charged to your Apple ID.

bluejetty:00123993:ios.name: Kelimelik Solo
bluejetty:00123993:ios.summary: Kelimelik Solo 15X15 bir tahta üzerinde, bilgisayara karşı oynanan ve internet bağlantısı gerektirmeyen bir kelime oyunudur. Oyunda sıra sizdeyken verilen harfler ile tahtadaki harfleri kullanarak tahta üzerinde anlamlı kelimeler oluşturman
bluejetty:00123993:ios.description:
Kelimelik Solo 15X15 bir tahta üzerinde, bilgisayara karşı oynanan ve internet bağlantısı gerektirmeyen bir kelime oyunudur. Oyunda sıra sizdeyken verilen harfler ile tahtadaki harfleri kullanarak tahta üzerinde anlamlı kelimeler oluşturmanız gerekmektedir. 
Oyun içerisinde farklı zorluk seviyelerini simgeleyen üç çeşit sanal karakter bulunmaktadır. Bu karakterler ile aynı anda beş oyuna kadar yeni oyun açabilir, kesintisiz olarak oyuna devam edebilirsiniz.
Kelimelik Solo oynarken yapacağınız bir hamleden alacağınız puan otomatik hesaplanarak gösterilmektedir. Bunun yanında bir hamlenin geçersiz olduğu da aynı şekilde otomatik olarak gösterilmektedir. Oyunumuzdaki Harf Tablosu özelliği ile de oyun esnasında hangi harften kaç tane kaldığını kolayca öğrenebilirsiniz.
Kelimelik Solo oyunumuzda haftalık ve tüm zamanlar için en iyiler listesi gösterilmektedir. Bu listede sizin için otomatik olarak oluşturulan anonim bir isim ile yer alırsınız ve eğer isterseniz bu ismi bir kereliğine ücretsiz olarak değiştirebilirsiniz. Daha sonraki değişimler için ise ödeme yapmanız gerekmektedir.
Kelimelik Solo geliştirme ve idame masraflarını karşılayabilmek için oyun içerisinde bulunan reklamlardan gelir sağlamaktadır. Yayınladığımız reklamlar ile siz oyuncularımıza verdiğimiz rahatsızlıktan dolayı özür dileriz.
İsterseniz oyun içi satın alım yaparak reklamları tamamen kapatabilirsiniz.
Oyunumuzda Türk Dil Kurumu Güncel Türkçe Sözlüğü 'nü referans almaktayız. Bu sözlüğe https://sozluk.gov.tr adresinden ulaşabilir, kelimelerimizi kontrol edebilirsiniz.
Oyunlarımızla ilgili güncel duyurulara ulaşmak için aşağıdaki kanallardan bizi takip edebilirsiniz:
Web: http://he2apps.com 
Facebook: http://facebook.com/KelimelikSolo
Twitter: http://twitter.com/KelimelikSolo
E-posta: iletisim@he2apps.com
Kelimelik Solo oyunumuzu indiren ve giriş yapan tüm kullanıcılarımız "Kelimelik Solo Üyelik ve Kullanım Sözleşmesi" içerisinde yer alan hükümleri okumuş, anlamış ve kabul etmiş sayılır. Kelimelik Solo Üyelik ve Kullanım Sözleşmesi belgesine aşağıdaki adresten ulaşabilirsiniz:
http://kelimelik.he2apps.com/kelimeliksolo_uyelik_sozlesmesi.html
He2 Apps:
- Deniz Aydınoğlu
- Neslihan Aydınoğlu
- Dilara Orçun

bluejetty:00121131:ios.description:
Curated wallpapers that refresh automatically.
Cuto handpicks beautiful wallpapers for your phone, so your screen always feels fresh — without endless scrolling.
Use automation tools to change wallpapers by time, mood, or routine.
- Featured by Apple CN App Store 10+ Times
- Featured in App Store "iPhone Essentials: Decorate Your New Device"
- App Store Editors' Pick
A beautiful image is just the beginning. A great wallpaper feels right on your screen.
For 10 years, we’ve chosen every Cuto wallpaper by hand—with care for the image itself, and how it looks on your phone.
[ A little more care. Every day. ]
One new wallpaper, every day. Handpicked by our editors, with no recommendation algorithms or automated image feeds. From daily finds to themed collections, there’s always something worth a closer look.
[ Have something in mind? Search for it. ]
An ocean view. A snowy day. A certain mood. Browse by color, theme, or atmosphere, or simply describe what you’re looking for. Try “sunrise over snowy mountains,” “something cheerful,” or “dark wallpapers for my Lock Screen.” Find a wallpaper that fits the feeling.
[ A view that moves you. ]
Bring a little motion to your Lock Screen with Cuto’s live wallpapers. Discover a scene you love, and watch it come to life when your screen wakes.
[ A fresh wallpaper. Automatically. ]
Keep things fresh without lifting a finger. Use Apple Shortcuts to change your wallpaper on a schedule that suits you, or switch it with a tap in Cuto. A new look, already taken care of.
[ More ways to enjoy your favorites. ]
See mountains and oceans through an airplane window, or give a favorite photo a frame. Cuto widgets bring a little scenery to your Home Screen and StandBy. And with progress wallpapers, you can see the year taking shape—or count down to a date that matters—right on your Lock Screen.
[ Thoughtfully designed. Beautiful to browse. ]
Liquid Glass meets carefully selected wallpapers. From the first look to your next favorite, finding a wallpaper should feel as good as it looks.
---
If you encounter any issues while using Cuto, please contact us through the "Feedback" feature in the app.

bluejetty:00080785:ios.description:
Billions of players can’t be wrong - run and jump back into the beloved world of Subway Surfers and rediscover your favorite endless running adventure with exciting new twists. Progress through fresh hurdles, reach new heights, and collect new characters! 
Jake, Tricky, Fresh, and Yutani are ready - are you? Play Subway Surfers City now!
Key features:
- CHOOSE YOUR ADVENTURE: Switch seamlessly between thrilling endless runs chasing a new high score, or playing the all new City Tour!
- UNCOVER SECRETS: Stomp and jump for a new way to play this runner game. Reach new depths and heights as you discover hard-to-reach Secret Stars!
- COLLECT AND UPGRADE SURFERS & BOARDS: Each Surfer and Board has unique abilities, so upgrade and combine runners and boards to play your way! Collect them all, find Surfer and Board tokens to upgrade them all and build the strongest Crew!
- WIN WITH NEW POWER-UPS & PERKS: Pick up new power-ups for the most powerful runs. Bubblegum shields you, batteries superpower your hoverboard, and drones get you to the highest points of Subway City! 
- UNLOCK LIVELY DISTRICTS: Explore all the secret corners of Subway City while running away from Guard and Dog. Earn XP to unlock new Districts!
- COMPLETE MISSIONS AND WIN REWARDS: The crew needs you to run your best! Play smart and finish missions to unlock new items and win big.
- CONQUER TRIALS: Are you ready to have your running skills challenged? Trials are adrenaline-pumping, limited runs that require your best performance to get the best rewards.
- PLAY OFFLINE: Subway Surfers City is available offline! Play without wifi or internet connection. Access to some features will be limited. 
Download Subway Surfers City now and play for free! Some in-game items can also be purchased for real money.

bluejetty:00127806:ios.description:
Heart Rate Pro is the latest safe, accurate and visual pulse checker & monitor on the market, feature-rich & easy to use, timely access to your health status.
Just open the app, you can measure your heart rate anytime, anywhere, show your best condition. let's go with it ~ 
Features:
1. Test Anywhere: you can measure your heart rate anytime, anywhere, concerned about heart health.
2. Simple operation: with your fingers on the back of the camera and flashlight, gently press, you can read the pulse in a few seconds. You can save your heart rate in a different state (such as exercise, rest, etc.) to a health center for easy observation of your heart rate changes.
3. Permanent preservation: the measurement results for permanent preservation, and provide visual display of exquisite statements.
4. Filtering different states : normal state, resting state and moving state.
5. Support for sharing heart rate results with Apple Health.
6. Timed Reminder: You can set a regular reminder, always remind you of regular test heart rate
7. Social Networking: support sharing to WeChat, QQ and other social newwork and family friends to show your health status .
HealthKit usages & instructions:
In order to facilitate the user to manage the heart rate data measured by the application, the heart rate uses HealthKit, as follows:
1. When you enable Health App Sharing in Settings, the app asks you for write access to your heart rate and resting heart rate via HealthKit. Once you've authorized it, the app will save your heart rate and resting heart rate data to the Apple Health App each time you save your heart rate. You can also deny authorization so that the app only saves heart rate data locally which will be deleted when the app is deleted.
2. The application will query the user for authorization of the application each time it enters the setting page to ensure that the switch status of the "Health Application Sharing" is correctly displayed;
3. If you want to no longer allow apps to use the Health app, you can open the "Health" app, select "Data Source" -> "HeartRatePro" and switch it off.
Use suggestions:
 1, in the city busy you, just take a few minutes to download heart rate, you can monitor your health every day, adjust your work and work status.
 2, in the love of germination, you can use the heart rate to pass your most authentic feelings for him and her eyebrows.
Warning： This is NOT for medical use!
Terms & Privacy Policy:http://www.dream8.top/apps/HeartRate/statement/privacy_en.html
