• Spend points for limited-edition collectibles, sets, content, rewards, or merchandise 
• Spend points to get instant savings on select LEGO® sets 
• Enter sweepstakes for money-can't-buy prizes 
Enjoy seasonal member offers and gifts with purchase
As part of the loyalty program, LEGO® Insiders receive member-only offers and limited-time gifts with purchase periodically throughout the year. 
• Receive limited gifts for qualifying purchases 
• Benefit from seasonal offers and rewards
Don’t forget early access
Members can skip the queue and get early access to fresh, new sets. 
• Get early access to sets as soon as you sign up 
• Enjoy early access to selected new sets
• Shop personalized set recommendations early
Built for LEGO® fans 18+
This app is designed for adults who want more from every LEGO® moment. That membership feeling starts here. 
Important information: 
• Free for LEGO® Insiders members aged 18+ (account required)
• Points, rewards, and discounts may vary by country
• Internet connection required

In Ark Nova, you will plan and design a modern, scientifically managed zoo. With the ultimate goal of owning the most
bluejetty:00116126:ios.description:
Plan and build a modern, scientifically managed zoo to support conservation projects in an acclaimed strategy board game.
In Ark Nova, you will plan and design a modern, scientifically managed zoo. With the ultimate goal of owning the most successful zoological establishment, you will build enclosures, accommodate animals, and support conservation projects all over the world. Specialists and unique buildings will help you in achieving this goal. 
At the heart of Ark Nova are 255 cards featuring animals, specialists, unique enclosures, and conservation projects, each with a particular ability. Use them to increase the appeal and scientific reputation of your zoo and to collect conservation points. Each player has a set of action cards, which you will use and upgrade to carry out your plans.
Each player has a set of five action cards to manage their gameplay, and the power of an action is determined by the slot the card currently occupies. The cards are:
BUILD: Allows you to build standard or special enclosures, kiosks, and pavilions.
ANIMALS: Allows you to accommodate animals in your zoo.
CARDS: Allows you to gain new zoo cards (animals, sponsors, and conservation project cards).
ASSOCIATION: Allows your association workers to carry out different tasks.
SPONSORS: Allows you to play a sponsor card in your zoo or to raise money.
With high replayability and rich components, Ark Nova provides a remarkable gaming experience that will bring the game to the table again and again.

bluejetty:00126765:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00126765:ios.description:
Study for your naturalization interview with a clear daily plan.
Learn American civics with questions, explanations and spoken practice.
Use this app to prepare before your interview and revisit answers you missed.
Start with a clear next step
Take a short diagnostic to see which topics need attention, then follow a daily study task. Explore American government, history and integrated civics at your own pace.
Practice, listen and review
Choose mock exams, timed practice or a quiet simulation with results at the end. Tap Listen to hear questions aloud, or say your answer before choosing it. Use flashcards to review and bookmarks to keep questions close.
Learn from missed answers
Smart Review collects questions you answered incorrectly. Answer a question correctly to remove it from your review list. Turn saved questions into a quiz for focused practice.
Keep a daily rhythm
Choose a daily question goal, follow your streak and set a study reminder. Add your test date to see a countdown.
Study beyond your connection
Once the questions have loaded, mock exams, topic practice, flashcards and Smart Review work without internet. Adjust the listening speed and use your phone's text size setting for comfortable reading.
Know what to expect
Review reading and writing word lists and guidance on how the civics test works. Practice uses the 2025 civics question bank, based on the civics test published by USCIS at uscis.gov. The app also explains the 2008 test rules, but does not include its question bank.
Rehearse an answer aloud
Set the question audio to a pace that suits your listening, then give your response aloud before selecting an option. This lets you pair hearing a civics prompt with putting an answer into your own voice.
Shape a quiz around your gaps
Build a practice session around the questions you bookmark, or return to mistakes gathered by Smart Review. As you get those missed questions right, they leave the list so your attention stays on remaining gaps.
Access and ad removal
Questions, explanations and practice tests are available with ads. Optional purchases remove ads.

Start with a clear next step

Practice, listen and review
Choose mock exams, timed practice or a quiet simulation with results at the end. Tap Listen to hear questions aloud, or say your answer before choosing it. Use flashcards to review and bookmarks to keep questions close.

Learn from missed answers
Smart Review collects questions you answered incorrectly. Answer a question correctly to remove it from your review list. Turn saved questions into a quiz for focused practice.

Keep a daily rhythm
Choose a daily question goal, follow your streak and set a study reminder. Add your test date to see a countdown.

Study beyond your connection
Once the questions have loaded, mock exams, topic practice, flashcards and Smart Review work without internet. Adjust the listening speed and use your phone's text size setting for comfortable reading.

Know what to expect
Review reading and writing word lists and guidance on how the civics test works. Practice uses the 2025 civics question bank, based on the civics test published by USCIS at uscis.gov. The app also explains the 2008 test rules, but does not include its question bank.

bluejetty:00163375:ios.name: Hamilton Island
bluejetty:00163375:ios.summary:
Description:
A handy pocket-guide to everything there is to see and do during your stay at Australia’s favourite resort destination – Hamilton Island. This on-island compendium is optimised for guests staying at Hotels owned or operated by
bluejetty:00163375:ios.description:
Description:
A handy pocket-guide to everything there is to see and do during your stay at Australia’s favourite resort destination – Hamilton Island. This on-island compendium is optimised for guests staying at Hotels owned or operated by Hamilton island Enterprises, but will be a handy tool to any visitor to the island. Where in the world would you rather be?
Features include:
- A live 'what’s-on' guide, with start-times, locations and hundreds of up-to-the minute listings of the daily activities & entertainment taking place across the island every day of the year
- Detailed Restaurant & Bar listings incorporating up-to-the-minute opening times, booking availability, insider tips, and entertainment schedules
- Ability to order take away and food delivery
- Detailed listings of all the facilities, activities, and services offered to guests on Hamilton Island, with prompts on how to book, and when they are next scheduled
- Navigate around Hamilton Island with detailed maps showcasing all points of interest, facilities, and retail outlets
- Shuttle Buses, and Ferry timetables for services on Hamilton Island
- Live flight arrival & departure information for services to Great Barrier Reef Airport (HTI) on Hamilton Island
- Live weather updates
- Live Special Offers and discounts highlighting any promotional offers currently running
- Make hotel bookings directly through the app
- And more
App Languages:
The Hamilton Island App is available in English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese. The app will automatically download in the phones default language. To download in a different language, you will need to change the default language on the phone. 
Connectivity:
This App requires a connection to either a Wi-Fi or cellular data network in order access the most up-to-date information. Free Wi-Fi hotspots are located across the island for guests staying at any Hotel operated by HIE. There are generally good cellular phone signals accessible from Telstra, Optus and Vodafone networks across the island, although guests should note that there are some isolated locations on the island that may have weak, or no cellular signal.

bluejetty:00088437:ios.summary:
Doctor Dash 2: Clinic ASMR – The Ultimate Time Management and Doctor Simulation Game! Ready to manage a hospital and perform crazy realistic asmr surgeries? Play now and become the top doctor in the big city!
Step into the shoes of a skil
bluejetty:00088437:ios.description:
Doctor Dash 2: Clinic ASMR – The Ultimate Time Management and Doctor Simulation Game! Ready to manage a hospital and perform crazy realistic asmr surgeries? Play now and become the top doctor in the big city!
Step into the shoes of a skilled doctor and build your dream hospital in this exciting and fun hospital simulation game. In Doctor Dash 2: Clinic ASMR, you’re in charge! Take control of a cute nurse and help her manage time and people. Don’t sit idle! Complete various tasks in order to save time: welcome patients, assign beds and bring them medication on time. Remember, you’re gonna go fast to keep the smiles on their faces. Complete levels to earn money and get extra tips for being quick – collect stars for perfect scores and get various rewards, from coins to extra customization for your characters. Travel from city to city and explore the world, rescuing everyone on your way.
Want a break from a challenge or management? Perform life-saving surgeries! Take care of infected wounds, broken bones and other extreme injuries. Enjoy realistic 2D graphics paired with ASMR sound effects and squishy animations. Tapping on your phone screen never felt so real! You can feel the tongue stretch with every move of a tool or hear satisfying pimple popping. Beat levels to unlock new surgeon mini-games and train to become a true miracle worker. Each patient brings a unique case, and it’s up to you to provide the best care possible. What kind of illness can you discover? Perform an extreme makeover and bring smiles back to your hospital.
Why You’ll Love Doctor Dash 2:
- Dash through endless levels and assist patients as they check into your hospital. Keep up with fast-paced time management challenges and deliver care with a smile. Tap fast, move faster!
- Perform realistic surgeries and operations to heal cuts, mend bones, and relieve pain, all while using real medical tools. Choose the correct one!
- Design and upgrade your hospital rooms to meet the growing needs of your patients. Make it a warm and inviting space to bring health and happiness to every patient. Turn a visit to the clinic into a luxury experience!
- Cute and charming cartoon characters , including babies, pets, and patients from all walks of life. Use your animal companion – a white adorable cat to calm everyone’s heart.
- Expand and build your hospital empire with the latest equipment, luxury beds, calming rooms, and advanced healthcare services. Level up your clinic!
- Collect coins, gems, and rewards as you progress to unlock new levels, tools, and hospital upgrades. Watch your small clinic grow into a grand hospital!
- An engaging mix of time management, simulation, and tycoon gameplay that will keep you glued to the screen for hours of fun!
- Challenge yourself or take it easy. Use boosters and upgrade skills to make your fast-paced medical care experience easier! Earn a 5-star rating as you create a calm and happy hospital… or turn it into a frenzy clinic of chaos!
- Enjoy special ASMR effects for a relaxing, satisfying gameplay experience that lets you unwind and focus.
Ready to start your medical journey and become a master nurse? Download Doctor Dash 2: Clinic ASMR now and explore the world of healthcare! Unlock the doors to your dream hospital, where every patient leaves with a happy smile and a healthy heart.

bluejetty:00062274:ios.name: Guitar Scales Power
bluejetty:00062274:ios.summary:
Guitar Scales Power will help guitar players at any level learn many of the most commonly used scales and modes. Stay in tune with the tuner and enhance your playing skills by mastering scale positions in any key.
Practice playing with sca
bluejetty:00062274:ios.description:
Guitar Scales Power will help guitar players at any level learn many of the most commonly used scales and modes. Stay in tune with the tuner and enhance your playing skills by mastering scale positions in any key.
Practice playing with scale position loops to perfect the position and build muscle memory. Learning scales will boost your finger dexterity and ability to improvise. Start slowly and increase speed as you progress.
Play scales by swiping across guitar strings; the direction of the swipe determines ascending or descending playback. Play scale position loops by tapping the play loop button. Tap on a note to play it.
Scale positions correspond to the CAGED system, which consists of five patterns that cover the fretboard for each scale. The chord shape for each position is displayed to assist you in learning it in any key.
The tuner offers a chromatic mode or the option to select from various tunings.
The tuner and instruments use an adjustable reference frequency, set to 410 Hz - 470 Hz (default A = 440 Hz).
FEATURES:
• Easy-to-use scale reference with excellent sound quality.
• Accurate chromatic tuner.
• Display and playback of scale positions covering the fretboard.
• Scale notes display letter, interval, and fingering.
• Displays CAGED system chord shapes for scale positions.
• Playback of scales - full position or one octave.
• Adjustable scale playback speed (position and position loop).
• Count-in option before scale playback.
• Notes highlight as played to aid in learning.
• Scale playback instruments: Guitar and Acoustic Guitar.
• Adjustable reference frequency for tuner and playback.
• Tap on a note to play it.
• Guitar fretboard display (vertical or horizontal).
• Right or left-handed guitar display.
• Supports alternative tunings.
• iPhone - zoom in/out to see the complete fretboard.
• Universal app – use on iPhone, iPod touch, or iPad.
• Everything included - no in-app purchases!
INCLUDED SCALES:
Pentatonic etc:
Major Pentatonic, Minor Pentatonic, Blues and Major Blues
Major Scale Modes:
Ionian (Major), Dorian, Phrygian, Lydian, Mixolydian, Aeolian (Relative Minor) and Locrian
Minor Scales:
Harmonic Minor, Melodic Minor Ascending (Jazz Minor) and Relative Minor (Natural Minor or Aeolian Mode)
Symmetrical Scales:
Chromatic
TUNINGS:
Standard, Std. Half Step Down, Std. Full Step Down, Drop D and Open G

bluejetty:00121550:ios.description:
LAYTON BROTHERS MYSTERY ROOM is a new crime-solving mystery game featuring none other than the son of the great Professor Layton!
*** DESCRIPTION ***
Genius investigator, Inspector Alfendi Layton and his newly assigned assistant, Detective Constable Lucy Baker, research only the most extraordinary cases in the “Mystery Room” deep within Scotland Yard. Investigate the evidence, find the contradictions, and unravel the truth that lies shrouded in mystery!
■ Investigate the Crime Scene
Uncover the details behind each crime as you zoom in and examine suspicious objects to add them to your mounting list of evidence. Piece them together to form an airtight case!
■ Cut Through the Web of Deceit!
Expose the crucial contradictions in the case files as you match them with evidence that just doesn’t add up. Call in the witnesses and find out if they have anything to hide!
■ Face the Culprit in the Final Showdown!
These criminal masterminds won’t make solving their heinous crimes easy. Find the holes in their arguments until their lies shatter around them, bringing the truth of each mystery to light!
■ These Mysteries and More Await!
File No.001: The Hand Sandwich
A woman was found murdered at the seaside hotel of a bustling travel destination. Her asphyxiated body lies on the balcony with one hand inside the sandwich that was to be her last meal.
Who is guilty of murder? What is the significance of the sandwich?
File No.002: The Bungled Burglary
A man was murdered inside his apartment. Two suspects emerge based on eyewitness testimonies, but the murder weapon seems to have vanished into thin air.
Who is the perpetrator, and what kind of murder weapon disappears from a locked room?
Pricing:
Play the prologue, Case File No.001, and Case File No.002 for FREE!
Files 3 through 6 and 7 through 9 are available as two separate in-app purchases.
■ Alfendi Layton’s Secret
As you expose the contradictions and culprits throughout each case, you may catch glimpses of a drastic change that occurs in Inspector Layton’s personality… Uncover the truth of Layton’s condition by solving the mystery of all nine files!
*** OFFICIAL WEBSITE ***
https://www.laytonseries.com/mystery-room/en/

Tired of constant interruptions from robocalls, telemarketers, and scammers? SpamSafe is the ultimate spam call blocker that gives you full control over your phone. With powerful tools like caller ID, call filter, call protect, and a customizable blacklist, you can enjoy safer and more peaceful communication.
Spam Call Blocker That Works
Say goodbye to unwanted calls. SpamSafe’s advanced spam call blocker detects and blocks known spam numbers. Stay protected from fraud, scams, and robocalls with a system designed to keep your phone clean. Enjoy a smarter way to block spam with an intuitive spam call blocker that works in real time.
Caller ID – Know Who’s Calling
No more guessing who’s calling. With enhanced caller ID, instantly identify callers—even those not saved in your contacts. Our caller ID engine reveals hidden numbers, scams, and telemarketers so you can decide whether to answer or block.
Call Filter & Blacklist Control
SpamSafe features a powerful call filter that screens incoming calls. Use the automatic filters or set your own rules. Add unwanted numbers to your blacklist and block them permanently. The call filter adapts to threats and stops them before they reach you. Manage your blacklist easily.
Trap Call & Scam Shield Features
Avoid falling victim to fraud. With our trap call feature, suspicious numbers are flagged before they can disturb you. Paired with our intelligent scam shield, SpamSafe protects you from spoofing and fake numbers. The trap call function intercepts threats early, while scam shield provides active real-time defense.
SMS Filtering with Call Filter Integration
Not just for calls—SpamSafe also protects your messages. Our SMS filter scans texts from unknown numbers and blocks unwanted content based on custom rules. Combine this with the call filter to stop distractions from all channels.
Call Protect for Ultimate Safety
Call protect offers advanced control and security by identifying and blocking spoofed or suspicious calls. When combined with the call filter, call protect ensures you receive only legitimate and relevant calls.
Custom Lists & Full Control
Create and manage your personal blacklist or whitelist with ease. Whether you're using caller ID, call protect, or trap call, these lists give you complete control. Tailor your call filter experience to your needs.
Scam Shield That Works
Our scam shield detects patterns in real time and flags calls from suspicious or spoofed numbers. With the combination of caller ID, call protect, and call filter, the scam shield acts as your digital firewall.

- Real-time caller ID to identify unknown numbers
- Intelligent call filter to block unwanted calls
- Create and manage your own blacklist
- Smart trap call functionality for added safety
- Active scam shield for fraud prevention
- Comprehensive call protect tools
- SMS filtering linked to your call filter
- Clean and easy-to-use interface

Your safety comes first. SpamSafe guards against spam, spoofing, and digital harassment. It offers more than a spam call blocker—it’s your all-in-one privacy tool with features like call protect, caller ID, and scam shield to keep you and your loved ones safe.

bluejetty:00162282:ios.summary: Feeling overwhelmed, anxious, or stressed? Struggling with depression, loneliness, or relationship issues? 7 Cups provides a trusted space for mental health support, professional therapy, stress relief and emotional support from experts—rig
bluejetty:00162282:ios.description:
Feeling overwhelmed, anxious, or stressed? Struggling with depression, loneliness, or relationship issues? 7 Cups provides a trusted space for mental health support, professional therapy, stress relief and emotional support from experts—right from your phone. Whether you need licensed counseling sessions, peer support, mental health services, talk therapy, advice or mindfulness exercises for anxiety and depression, we’re here to help with evidence-based practices and emotional guidance.
Connect with Licensed Therapists & Trained Listeners
• 24/7 emotional support through 1-on-1 text, chats and video with trained listener hotlines—for free. 
• Online therapy and counseling services with licensed professionals for deeper guidance.
• Join community, private and closed support groups, mental health forums & chat rooms to share experiences and find encouragement.
Mental Health Support for Anxiety, Stress & Depression
• Manage anxiety and panic attacks with guided mindfulness and therapeutic breathing exercises.
• Reduce stress and boost your mood with over 300 free mental health exercises, self-care activities, and virtual guides.
• Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) techniques to help reframe negative thoughts.
• Personalized self help tools and mental health care with our free wellness test.
Why Choose 7 Cups for Counseling & Therapy?
• Confidential & Anonymous: Your identity remains private—even from your therapist or listener. 
• Flexible & Affordable: Free emotional support sessions and low-cost online therapy options for individuals without insurance.
• Recognized & Trusted Treatments: An award-winning mental health app, acknowledged by Stanford MedicineX for innovation in healthcare.
• Inclusive & Accepting: We support everyone, regardless of age, gender, sex, or background
• Group support: Share your experiences and gain new insights in support groups with licensed therapists.
Find Support Anytime, Anywhere
Life’s challenges don’t follow a schedule. Whether you’re dealing with work stress, anxiety, depression, trauma, relationship problems, divorce self-esteem issues or you just want to talk to someone, finding a therapist or counselor can be a time-consuming and expensive process. You can’t always talk to friends, family, or coworkers, that’s why 7 Cups provides instant mental health support, remote counseling services, advice, and stress relief—anytime you need it. 
100% Confidential Mental Health Help & Chat:
Remain 100% anonymous. No one will ever know who you are—not even your listeners, counselor or therapist.
7 Cups’ Listeners Care About You:
Our listeners are volunteers. They aren’t getting paid; they’re here because they want to help.
We have over 450,000 trained listeners, licensed therapists and social workers to help you. Listeners provide support across 189 countries and in 140 languages. Each listener has a profile with reviews and a list of categories that they specialize in, ranging from panic attacks and bullying to eating disorders, surviving a breakup, and more.
When you find the listener you want, connect instantly via chat. Chat with a new listener each time or pick one and develop a deeper ongoing relationship.
FAST & FREE:
The app is free to download and all listeners are available to chat 100% free. After you download the app, you can start a conversation in less than 60 seconds.
Join millions who trust 7 Cups for emotional wellness. Download today and start feeling better!
Terms of Service - https://www.7cups.com/Documents/TermsOfService
Privacy Policy - https://www.7cups.com/Documents/PrivacyPolicy

• Invite unlimited number of family and friends to join in on the baby watching fun.
• Add additional monitors to extend your care circle to your home, pets, elderly family members, even plants!

bluejetty:00119637:ios.name: Super Backup : Contacts & SMS
bluejetty:00119637:ios.summary: Your texts and contacts hold years of conversations, addresses and phone numbers you can't afford to lose. Super Backup keeps them safe right on your iPhone, no computer needed. Back up your SMS and iMessage chats, save all your contacts to
bluejetty:00119637:ios.description:
Your texts and contacts hold years of conversations, addresses and phone numbers you can't afford to lose. Super Backup keeps them safe right on your iPhone, no computer needed. Back up your SMS and iMessage chats, save all your contacts to a file you can restore on any phone, and clean up your photo library while you're at it.
SMS & IMESSAGE BACKUP
Save the conversations that matter before you switch phones, free up space or lose them by accident.
• Back up SMS and iMessage chats directly on your iPhone. No Mac, no PC, no cable
• Choose how far back to go: last 7 days, 30 days, 12 months or everything
• Long chats are backed up in small date steps, so even your busiest days come through complete
• Read your backed-up chats in the app as familiar chat bubbles, with your texts on the right
• Back up again anytime: new messages are added and nothing is saved twice
• After a quick one-time setup, backups run in the background while you stay in Super Backup
• A short video tutorial walks you through setup step by step
EXPORT YOUR TEXTS YOUR WAY
• PDF: a clean, printable transcript with chat bubbles, dates and page numbers
• Spreadsheet (CSV): opens in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets with emoji and accents intact
• Text file (TXT): simple and readable anywhere
• Another OS file: move your one-to-one chats to an Another OS phone with a free SMS restore app
• Export one chat or all of them in a single file, then share by AirDrop, Mail, Files and more
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Super Backup uses Apple's free Shortcuts app to read only the chats you choose, only when you ask. Your texts go straight into Super Backup and stay on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
CONTACTS BACKUP
• Back up all your contacts in one tap to a standard VCF (vCard) file
• Restore them on any iPhone or Another OS phone, or import them into most email and address book apps
• Keep a backup history showing the date, number of contacts and file size of each backup
• Save or share backups with Files, iCloud Drive, AirDrop, Mail and more
CONTACTS CLEANUP
• Find duplicate contacts, plus contacts that share a phone number or email
• Spot incomplete contacts with no name, no phone number or no email
• Merge duplicates into one complete contact
• Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep
• Built-in safety net: Super Backup creates a backup automatically before deleting any contact
PHOTO CLEANUP & WI-FI TRANSFER
• Swipe through your photos month by month and delete the junk
• Find duplicate and look-alike photos and videos, and keep the best copy
• Review large videos, Live Photos, screenshots and media saved from social and messaging apps
• Send photos to your Mac or PC over Wi-Fi from any web browser: browse your albums and download a whole album as a ZIP. No cable, no iCloud
FREE PLAN
• Back up 1 SMS chat (its 10 newest messages) and export it as PDF, CSV, TXT or an Another OS file
• Back up up to 100 contacts per backup file
• Clean up to 7 photos and 3 contacts per day
PREMIUM
• Unlimited SMS chats and messages, with several chats backed up at once
• Unlimited contacts in every backup
• Unlimited photo and contact cleanup
• Wi-Fi photo transfer to Mac and PC
Choose a weekly or yearly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase.
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase.
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends.
• You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple Account settings.
• If a free trial is offered, any unused part of it ends when you buy a subscription.
Privacy Policy Link : https://www.dropouts.in/privacypolicy/privacy-policy.html
Terms and Conditions Link : https://www.dropouts.in/privacypolicy/terms-of-use.html

bluejetty:00044286:ios.name: Spoolstock - 3D Printing Hub
bluejetty:00044286:ios.summary: If you are 3D printing, either professionally or personally, you have to manage your progress and your materials. Spoolstock helps you keep track of what you have, what you use, what you like, and what you spend. Keep all your materials and
bluejetty:00044286:ios.description:
If you are 3D printing, either professionally or personally, you have to manage your progress and your materials. Spoolstock helps you keep track of what you have, what you use, what you like, and what you spend. Keep all your materials and prints in one place, on your phone or your tablet.
-------------
You can start today for free for up to 20 filaments, spools, and prints. If you find Spoolstock useful in your 3D printing process, upgrade to a Maker subscription for unlimited access to filaments, spools, prints, and much more!
-------------
Comprehensive filament inventory management: Easily track your filament inventory with detailed data points. Use QR/barcode scanning for quick access, add photos, note purchase prices, and customize inventory locations and attributes.
Intelligent filament tracking: Know exactly how much filament is left on each spool. Spoolstock's smart system calculates remaining filament using an extensive database of empty spool weights.
Enhanced print tracking: Monitor your 3D prints with precision. Spoolstock supports multi-material prints and automatically updates filament availability based on usage during prints.
Depletion notifications: Stay informed with notifications when a filament spool is running low or has been depleted.
Usage statistics: Gain insights into your printing habits with stats on filament types, brands, colors, and materials used.
Flexible workflow integration: Designed to adapt to various workflows, Spoolstock is the perfect companion for both hobbyists and professional 3D printing setups.
Multi-device cloud syncing: All data is associated with your Spoolstock account and is always up-to-date. Your data is stored in the cloud and can be accessed from anywhere on any device.
Customized label printing: Build a print queue and print labels for your spools quickly and easily. QR codes on every spool for quick scanning and easy access. Supports most wi-fi enabled label printers. 
NEW! Keep track of your spools with custom NFC tags: Easily tap to find your spools.
-------------
We are a small development team passionate about 3D printing. Our goal is to make Spoolstock the best possible platform to manage your 3D printing workflow so you can optimize your processes and increase your productivity. We are brand new, but have big plans for future updates and features. Stay tuned as this tool continues to grow and change as we work together with our users to provide regular updates and new features.

bluejetty:00069641:ios.description:
Stepz is a convenient step counter app that leverages the clever Apple Motion Coprocessor which collects your motion data automatically in the background while saving battery life. This simple pedometer app has been specifically developed for the iPhone and Apple Watch.
Do you move enough throughout the day? Learn more about your daily activity and get fit by reaching your step goal! To provide you with a complete overview of your fitness progress, Stepz can import all your past steps from the Apple Health app.
Stepz respects your privacy: all your personal fitness data is stored internally on your device and never shared via a network connection without your explicit consent.
* Featured by Apple on the App Store Home Page under Best New Apps in 22 countries (April 2015) *
* FEATURES *
- Full Apple Health integration
- Automatically records your steps
- Very accurate and no GPS needed
- Runs in the background with very low battery drain
- Daily, weekly, monthly, yearly and hourly step values
- Distance calculation
- Set your daily step goal
- Shows floors climbed
- Apple Watch app with clever data syncing
- Connect with your friends
* PREMIUM FEATURES *
- iOS Today Widget for Notification Center
- App icon badge shows your step count
* USER REVIEWS *
"Now that I have got this Stepz app I have stopped looking for any other system it is the very best to keep me on track.You have to try it once tried there is no looking back." (Sep 2018)
"I love this app. It is just the tool I needed for motivation to walk more. Thanks. Keep up the good work." (Jul 2018)
"Love love this step app. I've tried a couple others and read the reviews for STEPZ......decided to try "just 1 more". It's the best one I've tried! Love the calorie counting on this one too. Even the health one that comes with the iPhone doesn't compare to this one. Thank you!" (Nov 2017)

• The cost of renewal will be charged to your account in the 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.

bluejetty:00033131:ios.description:
Falling ill while abroad can be an extremely stressful experience - especially when you need to navigate a foreign healthcare system and can’t speak the local language.
This is where Air Doctor comes in.
The easy-to-use app helps you find trusted local doctors near you so you can schedule an appointment with a doctor who meets your requirements - with just a few taps. 
All the doctors and specialists in our medical network are trusted, licensed, and vetted professionals who are qualified to treat you. You can browse over 20,000 doctors and filter according to medical specialty, location, gender, language, and more. bluejetty:00069653:ios.description:
Toronto Life magazine is the destination for people who care about Toronto, Canada’s most vibrant city. It provides insight into the personalities and events that shape the landscape of the city, and helps readers make informed choices about everything from restaurants and shopping to real estate and culture.
Toronto Life offers an exciting, essential and entertaining guide to life in Toronto through its in-depth reporting, intelligent analysis and quality writing. Our app features the magazine's content for tablet and mobile.
The app is free for paid print subscribers. New app subscribers receive a one-month free trial. Please note that the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current subscription, and you will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current subscription. You can cancel a subscription during the free trial period through your device's account settings.
----------------------------------------------
This is a free app download. Within the app users can purchase the current issue and back issues.
Subscriptions are also available within the application. A subscription will start from the latest regular issue at the time of purchase.
-The subscription will renew automatically unless cancelled more than 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, for the same duration and at the current subscription rate for the product.
-You may turn off the auto-renewal of subscriptions through your Account Settings, however you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period.
-Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase and any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when a subscription to that publication is purchased.
-If a subscription offers a free trial, at the end of the trial period, you will be charged the full price of the subscription. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription settings on your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged.
Users can register for/ login to a pocketmags account in-app. This will protect their issues in the case of a lost device and allow browsing of purchases on multiple platforms. Existing pocketmags users can retrieve their purchases by logging into their account.
We recommend loading the app for the first time in a wi-fi area so that all issue data is retrieved.
If your app will not load past the splash page after a first install or an update, please delete and reinstall the app from the App Store
Help and frequently asked questions can be accessed in-app and on pocketmags.
If you have any problems at all please do not hesitate to contact us: help@pocketmags.com
--------------------

http://www.pocketmags.com/privacy.aspx

bluejetty:00071283:ios.summary:

You'll find an app full of learning games based on mental calculation for getting the hang of the multiplication and being able to remember them! Using our app, you can
bluejetty:00071283:ios.description:
Learn the times tables with this fun and creative math app for kids. 
You'll find an app full of learning games based on mental calculation for getting the hang of the multiplication and being able to remember them! Using our app, you can learn all of the tables in order, by random selection or the other way around! You choose how you want to learn them: The important thing is becoming a times tables whiz! 
THE APP ADAPTS TO YOUR LEVEL!
Our maths app is perfect for a wide range of learners, from those who are just starting out with their basic mutiplication tables (2x, 3x) as well as those that already have them down to a tee but want to practice them again to get their mental arithmetic up to speed. You decide which ones you want to practice and the time that suits you!
GIVE MULTIPLAYER A GO!
Our learning-based game lets you play on your own or in a group, taking advantage of our multiplayer mode. Challenge your classmates and become the quickest at mental maths by working out and mastering the different activities. 
BECOME THE TIMES TABLES KING!
Taking just a few minutes out of your day to play with this app will allow you to improve your calculation and adding up skills while beating your own records and scores, and your parents can follow up your progress in each table.
WHY IS MENTAL ARITHMETIC IMPORTANT?
Mental maths is not only an important part of the syllabus as a school subject but also something we all need to do so with many things in everyday life. For example, adding up the prices of food as you're doing your weekly shop in the supermarket or working out percentages for those sales bargains! That's why mental arithmetic is something essential that you'll always need! 
EDUCATIONAL GOALS
- Improving mental calculation
- Learning to multiply quickly. Become an adding up expert!
- Improving speed of doing different multiplications and mental maths challenges
COMPANY: Didactoons Games SL
Recommended age group: For Primary and Secondary school kids aged between 6 and 14 years old. 
Theme: Multiplayer game for mental arithmetic and times tables.
CONTACT US
We want to know what you think of the app! Please don't hesitate to ask questions, tell us about technical issues, give suggestions or whatever else you fancy sharing with us.
Get in touch using our contact form: https://www.didactoons.com/contact/

bluejetty:00136441:ios.description:
Boredom or awkward silence no more. Talkbro gives access to 5,000+ conversation starters in the form of topics, questions, quizzes, and games, to create lasting moments of intimacy, bonding, stomach-tickling excitement, or authentic entertainment.
Dive into fun quizzes, exciting games, and thought-provoking questions that foster connection and deepen understanding. 
■ FOR ALL TYPES OF RELATIONSHIPS
We’ve all been there. Weird silences when you are hanging out with new people. Don’t know what to talk about. Dull nights with your husband/wife or gf/bf. Uneventful date nights. Losing the spark. 
Talkbro is here to change that by giving you an enormous database of conversation starters.
Whether you are new partners or longtime companions, talkbro offers a unique, interactive platform to explore and grow your relationship. There are also conversation topics for friends and family. Bring fun and meaningful conversations into your daily routine with talkbro
■ ORGANIZED IN CATEGORIES
With a wide range of categories to choose from, the app caters to every mood and occasion. Whether you're on a first date, spending quality time with family, or enjoying a lively party, this app has you covered. Here are the categories you can choose on talkbro:
● Family – perfect for family hangouts
● Couple – ideal for date nights, strengthening the bond or exploring the relationships
● Friends – have fun with your bestie or group of close friends
● Favorite (click the heart icon on any of the cards. They will be kept here).
■ THOUGHT-PROVOKING QUESTIONS
Each conversation starter category contains a unique set of intriguing questions that inspire deep conversations, laughter, and memorable moments. Get to know your friends, family, or romantic interests on a whole new level. 
Use talkbro with your favorite people, or new people that you want to meet on a more personal level without being weird. Use it to never run out of ideas on what to talk about in almost any situation of your life.
Bring people together and strengthen your relationships with the app, your go-to source for engaging and heartfelt conversations.
► Download talkbro for FREE and transform every gathering into an unforgettable bonding experience!
__________
UNLOCK ALL TALKBRO QUESTIONS
Get all conversation starters and questions with our affordable subscription plans.
Subscription payments will be debited from your iTunes account upon confirmation of your purchase and at the beginning of each renewal period. You can cancel your subscription or free trial in iTunes settings at least 24 hours before the end of each current subscription period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service.
Terms of use: https://sites.google.com/view/termsandconditions-pomapps
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/privacypolicy-pomapps

bluejetty:00183331:ios.description:
Discover the Best Vegan and Vegetarian Restaurants Anywhere!
For over 25 years, HappyCow has been the number 1 guide for finding delicious plant-based, healthy dining options wherever you go. With over 240,000 listings in 185 countries, we make it easy to explore the world of vegan and vegetarian cuisine.
Key Features:
• Powerful Search & Filters: Find restaurants near you, and plan trips ahead. Filter by vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, raw cuisine, and more!
• Interactive Maps: Explore popular and “hidden gem” restaurants on our community-curated maps. Save favorites for offline access.
• Extensive Reviews: Access 1,875,000+ restaurant reviews and 3,000,000+ photos from others like you
• Engage with the Community: Instantly be part of the world’s largest vegan and vegetarian community. Follow and connect with like-minded people, leave reviews, create shareable trips, and view photos and reviews on the Feed
• 9 Languages: Access main app features in English, Spanish, French, German, Dutch, Italian, Japanese, Mandarin, and Cantonese. 
Why HappyCow?
• We’re the world’s largest vegan platform, with an established 25 year legacy!
• Travel confidently with extensive global coverage and user-generated content.
• Find the best vegan food near you with detailed reviews, photos, directions and more.
• Our passionate community of over 1.2 million is here to support you no matter where you go. 
Discover plant-based, healthy dining in a new way, and never miss the best dining experiences near you!
Don't see your favorite vegan or vegetarian spot?
List it on HappyCow and help grow our ever-expanding database!
If you’re having trouble with the app, contact us at ios@happycow.net before leaving a review. We're here to help!
Download HappyCow now and unlock a world of delicious plant-based adventures!

bluejetty:00151929:ios.description:
UNLOCK THE MINDSET, SKILLS, AND STRATEGIES TO WIN
The Operator Standard is the world's first lifestyle operating system. Designed to develop the bulletproof mindset, relentless discipline, and unshakable confidence it takes to thrive in life ... business ... and relationships.
But understand this ... this isn’t your average cookie-cutter information you'll get anywhere else. This is real, raw, no-B.S. guidance for those who are ready to lead ... dominate ... and create lasting impact in the world.
If you’re tired of the gimmicks, gurus and empty promises ... then look no further. This app will help you unlock and execute at your highest level.
Here’s what you’ll get:
**LESSONS TO DOMINATE EVERY AREA OF LIFE**
Get step-by-step guidance on everything from building mental toughness and grit to manifesting your goals and executing at the highest level.
**THE TOOLS TO MAXIMIZE YOUR POTENTIAL**
This isn’t about staying comfortable. It's about rising to the challenge, taking calculated risks, and pushing yourself further than you ever thought possible. Track your critical tasks with your daily Power List; participate in Challenges designed to level up your life; compete with your friends in Leaderboards; reflect on your day with the Journal; track your progress and stay accountable with Streaks and Strikes … and MUCH more.
**PERSONALIZED AI GUIDANCE … WHERE YOU NEED IT**
AI that knows you and your goals and is there wherever you need it to provide guidance, critical task suggestions, coaching, challenges, answers and feedback. 
**AN ACTIVE COMMUNITY OF WINNERS**
Connect with people like you … hungry, driven, and unapologetically committed to making the world better through excellence and entrepreneurship.
**THE BLUEPRINT FOR TRUE LEADERSHIP**
Learn how to inspire, lead, and hold a high standard for yourself and others in a world that desperately needs strong leaders.
The Operator Standard is for those who understand that it’s our responsibility to lead ... win ... and build a legacy of greatness.
If you’re ready to level up and take control of your life, download The Operator Standard now.
------------------------------------------------
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Access to The Operator Standard is available with a monthly membership subscription. Membership is available for $49.99 per month or $549.99 per year and will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. These prices are for US customers. Pricing in other countries may vary. Payment will be charged to your Apple account at confirmation of purchase.

bluejetty:00026292:ios.description:
The 511 Manitoba app provides near real-time highway and traffic information to drivers to help them safely plan their route. This includes information on construction, incidents, road closures, and weather alerts on roads across the province. 
This app features a scrollable, zoomable map that displays: 
• Road Conditions 
• Incidents and closures, such as collisions and other road hazards 
• Cameras 
• Construction
• Road Closures
• Traffic Information 
• Weather alerts
The app also features audio alerts that notify drivers of incidents, construction, road closures, and other road events.
This app provides information and support in both English and French.

bluejetty:00032496:ios.summary:
Geneva Bible with audio narration, AI Bible Chat, daily verses, study plans, devotionals, prayer, and offline reading.
Explore the Geneva Bible with modern tools designed to help you understand Scripture, strengthen your faith, and build a
bluejetty:00032496:ios.description:
Geneva Bible with audio narration, AI Bible Chat, daily verses, study plans, devotionals, prayer, and offline reading.
Explore the Geneva Bible with modern tools designed to help you understand Scripture, strengthen your faith, and build a daily Bible habit.
Read, listen, highlight, study, and pray every day with access to all 66 books of the Old and New Testament.
WHAT YOU WILL FIND INSIDE
• COMPLETE GENEVA BIBLE — Read all 66 books of the Old and New Testament and explore this historic English Bible translation.
• AUDIO BIBLE — Listen to Bible chapters at home, while traveling, walking, resting, or whenever you want to hear God's Word.
• AI BIBLE CHAT — Ask questions about Scripture, passages, biblical themes, faith, or Christian life and receive easy-to-understand answers grounded in the Bible.
• DAILY VERSE & PRAYER — Start your day with an inspiring Bible verse and guided prayer.
• HIGHLIGHTS & NOTES — Highlight verses, add bookmarks, and save personal notes while you study.
• OFFLINE BIBLE — Read Scripture without an internet connection.
• STUDY PLANS — Build a consistent Bible habit with guided reading and study plans.
• DAILY DEVOTIONAL — Grow in faith through short devotional readings and reflections.
• HOME SCREEN WIDGET — Keep Scripture visible throughout your day.
• BIBLE SEARCH — Quickly find verses, words, passages, and topics across Scripture.
GROW IN GOD'S WORD
Whether you want to understand a difficult passage, explore a biblical topic, strengthen your faith, or build a daily Bible habit, Geneva Bible gives you tools to read, listen, study, pray, and reflect.
Ask AI Bible Chat when you have questions, follow study plans to go deeper, listen to Scripture throughout your day, or continue reading where you left off.
A HISTORIC BIBLE FOR TODAY
The Geneva Bible holds an important place in the history of the English Bible. Explore this historic translation while enjoying modern Bible reading and study features in one app.
SCRIPTURE FOR EVERY SEASON
Explore God's Word throughout Christmas, Easter, Good Friday, Lent, and other meaningful moments of the Christian year with Scripture, reflection, and prayer.
FOR EVERYONE
Whether you are discovering the Bible for the first time, interested in historic English Bible translations, returning to God's Word, studying with your family, or serving in church ministry, Geneva Bible makes daily Scripture reading simple and meaningful.
PREMIUM — OPTIONAL
Unlock additional features through available premium plans.
Premium options may include auto-renewing subscriptions, fixed-term access, lifetime access, or other one-time purchases.
Premium may include eligible study features and an ad-free experience according to the selected plan.
AI Bible Chat and other AI features may be subject to usage limits or credits depending on the selected plan. Lifetime or one-time purchases do not necessarily include unlimited AI usage.
For auto-renewing subscriptions, payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.
One-time purchase options do not automatically renew.
Prices, plans, availability, and included features may vary by country or region. Exact details will be shown before purchase.

bluejetty:00098154:ios.description:
Have the perfect Bible verses curated for you with Waves!
Looking for scriptures that speak directly to what is currently going on in your life? Waves is a curated Bible verse app that helps you grow spiritually by delivering handpicked verses tailored to the areas you want to improve. Whether you seek guidance, strength, peace, love, or wisdom, you’ll find verses that resonate with your personal journey.
Key Features:
Mood Check In Slider - Share your feelings daily with a mood check-in that will curate scriptures for how you are feeling and what you are going through!
Lock Screen & Home Screen Widgets – Stay connected to God’s Word with Bible verses that refresh every two hours, keeping inspiration just a glance away.
Customizable Reminders – Set up daily notifications to receive uplifting scripture as often as you need throughout your day.
Waves Chat – Get instant explanations of verses, devotionals, and personalized scripture recommendations based on what you're going through. You can also ask anything, and receive faith-based guidance!
Explore by Life Topics – Connect with scripture that aligns with your personal experiences. Whether you're facing challenges, seeking encouragement, or deepening your faith, find Bible verses that truly resonate.
Daily Spiritual Growth – Let God’s Word shape your life with carefully curated verses that inspire, motivate, and strengthen your faith.
Transform your spiritual journey today—download now and let the Bible speak directly to your heart!
Subscription prices and terms:
Go Premium for an elevated Waves: Bible Verse Experience with Waves Premium to unlock all topics and full access to Waves Chatbot. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.

bluejetty:00044089:ios.description:
Use Whitelines App when you want to: 
・Capture your notes.
・Save your notes.
・Share your notes on Social Media, email, etc.
・Continue to work and edit your notes digitally. 
The Whitelines App will capture your notes automatically when it detects all four corner codes on your Whitelines Paper and adjust the image to make it useful to you. 
When using Whitelines Paper the app removes the background, so all that remains is your writing or drawing over a white background. 
Whitelines App is perfect when you want to:
・ Review your notes on the go before an exam.
・ Share notes from a class with a friend.
・ Include a handmade drawing in a presentation.
・ Post an illustration or note to Instagram.
CAPTURE YOUR NOTES WITH WHITELINES APP
1. Tap the camera icon to enter capture mode. Whitelines App will capture your note automatically when it detects the full page (including all four corner codes), with the logo at the bottom of the page. Or, if you use other than Whitelines Paper tap the button to scan the note manually. Before scanning, choose between “Auto” or “Manual” to tell Whitelines App to remove the background automatically or to edit the image yourself.
2. If you have several pages of notes that you’d like to save as a stack, simply stay in the capture mode and continue to capture pages one at a time. Of course, you can also save your notes to existing stacks in the app.
3. Save, Use, Edit and Share the Notes
Choose if you’d like to save your note locally on your phone, or if you’d like to share it–with yourself or with somebody else. You can share your note with any app that processes image files, such as WhatsApp, Instagram, OneDrive, OneNote, Google Drive, Evernote, Dropbox, Line, Facebook installed on your phone. Tick the boxes on the Whitelines Paper to email the note or save it to Dropbox or Evernote.
SUPPORT
If you need help with anything or have any questions about the app, feel free to read our FAQ. Is something not working as expected? Get in touch with us! We’d love to know where we have room for improvement. Your feedback is important, as it helps guide our future efforts. 
FEEDBACK
Please give us your thoughts on Whitelines App, and let us know what we could do to make it better. It helps us develop the features you want. We’re already thinking about what our next step should be in order to best support your ideas and help you set them free. This update of the app is a step in our efforts to create a digital/analog interface for note-taking that will help you grow, learn the things you want to know, pass exams, and collaborate creatively. 
Contact us at support@whitelines.se 
//////////////////////////////////////////
WHITELINES LOVES TO SEE YOU GROW!
We’re so happy that you’re here with us, with all your knowledge, all the thoughts that pass through your mind, and all the things you want to learn and do. If you like, we’d love to join you on your journey, and help you in every way we can. 
We want our white lines to support you in your quest for new knowledge, as you challenge past truths and look for creative solutions to problems. We want that because we believe in the innate genius of every human being, and in the power of collaboration. When human beings help and challenge each other, it makes the world a better place!
The note on page one among the images above was made by Juliette Croce (Instagram: @julestudy) from the USA. 
The note on page two among the images above was made by Karin Verdoes (Instagram: @evabrittakarin) from Sweden.

VICTORY Channel is your ultimate destination for empowering content that uplifts your spirit and fuels your faith—24/7.
Faith permeates every area of our lives, and on VICTORY Channel, we have programming for your spirit, mind, and body. From ministry preaching and talk shows, to on-the-road excursions and political coverage, everything we broadcast is in the spirit of faith.
From morning prayer times that set a positive tone for your day, to evening news coverage that helps you see current events in light of the gospel, VICTORY Channel is your constant companion all day long. Hit “play” and discover what the Bible says about healing, finances, relationships, overcoming troubles, spiritual warfare, parenting, praise and worship, finding your calling and more…all from seasoned ministers you can trust.
Programs include:
* Believer’s Voice of Victory with Kenneth and Gloria Copeland
* FlashPoint

* Morning Prayer

VICTORY Channel began in 2015 as the next step in fulfilling the call God gave to Kenneth Copeland in 1967 to preach the uncompromised Word of God on every available voice—from the top of the world to the bottom and all the way around the middle.
From the beginning, Kenneth and Gloria Copeland wanted to allow other faith-filled, Spirit-led ministers to be part of VICTORY and share God’s Word with the world. They wanted viewers to learn the principles of faith, as outlined in Scripture, and how to apply those principles of faith each day.

bluejetty:00128046:ios.summary:
Sequel to one of iOS’s #1 puzzle games, The Guides Axiom introduces a myriad of entirely new codes, puzzles and interactive ciphers to challenge your wit, stretch your imagination and test your ingenuity in unique and innovative ways.
Simp
bluejetty:00128046:ios.description:
Sequel to one of iOS’s #1 puzzle games, The Guides Axiom introduces a myriad of entirely new codes, puzzles and interactive ciphers to challenge your wit, stretch your imagination and test your ingenuity in unique and innovative ways.
Simply stated, they’re not easy. Progressing will be difficult, but you have the appropriate tools at your disposal. Everything you need to proceed is — or has been — provided.
Look for clues and patterns to build on what you have learned. Remember what you have seen as for no detail is too subtle or insignificant. As you explore deeper, you’ll begin to unravel the enigma of The Guides Axiom.
Peculiar, isn't it?
• • • • • • •
Features:
• Includes more than 100 meticulously designed interactive puzzles, ciphers and secrets to discover — with many more on the way.
• Integrated decoding tools — including morse, binary and several others — to assist you on your journey.
• Reimagined level select system and nonlinear gameplay give you the freedom to explore a much broader path.
• Ability to save screenshots and record notes to help keep track of invaluable clues.
• Stuck? Extract a hint by using a Hack to obtain the inspiration needed to move forward.
• There are many layers of complexity so don't assume a puzzle has only one solution.
• • • • • • •
Official Site: theguidesapp.com
General Inquiries: info@theguidesapp.com
Twitter: twitter.com/theguidesapp

bluejetty:00118940:ios.description:
DatChat is a private social networking app and messenger that protects your privacy with self-destructing, screenshot protected, encrypted posts and messages.
Get the security you deserve. Keep your messages and social posts private, secure, and out of the wrong hands. Our proprietary anti-screenshot protection makes it nearly impossible for others to screenshot messages, posts, or comments - and you will receive a notification that they even tried. Every message you send has an end-to-end encrypted connection.
Control over messages doesn’t stop after you hit send - now you have control even after they are sent. “Nuke” conversations on both the sender and recipient’s devices to protect your privacy. You can also unsend messages with ease. Messages will vanish without trace when they reach view limits or are manually destructed.
Using DatChat is like having your own private social network. Create Social Groups where only you and the friends you invite to the group can post, comment, and like. Have as many accounts as you like, with whatever friends and family you want. Secure, private messages and pictures are only visible when logged into that respective account.
Only your profile picture is available for anyone to view on DatChat. All other photos and information are in a private camera roll, hidden and encrypted behind other pictures. Never worry about picture security again.
Download DatChat today and enjoy free, private, and secure social networking.
DATCHAT FEATURES:
Free, Secure Messaging:
- Private messenger protects your privacy
- Propriety anti-screenshot protection makes it nearly impossible to screenshot a message, post, or comment
- Receive notifications when someone attempts to screenshot messages, photos, or videos
- Only the sender & intended recipients can view messages - they cannot be forwarded to others
- Every message has an end-to-end encrypted connection
Post-Send Control:
- Control what happens to messages even after you send them
- Self-destructing messages & posts protect your privacy
- “Nuke” messages & completely eradicate both sides of a conversation, comments, and more
- Messages & posts vanish without a trace when they reach a view limit or are manually destructed
Secure Social Networking:
- Create Social Groups where only you & your invited friends can post, comment, and like
- Group & individual conversations available
- Multiple accounts for different friends: messages are visible when logged into that respective account
Picture Privacy:
- Only the cover photo can be seen in plain sight
- Senders can hide pictures and information on the camera roll, hidden & encrypted behind other pictures
Download DatChat now to start sending secure, private messages.
__
We now offer DatChat Pro at three membership tiers:
- Monthly: $0.99, renews every month
- Yearly: $9.99, renews annually
- Lifetime: $24.99, one-time purchase good for the life of your account
DatChat Pro is an optional subscription service that unlocks new features and removes existing limitations. Subscriptions are offered on a monthly, yearly, and lifetime basis. Monthly subscriptions will renew every month for $0.99. Yearly subscriptions will renew annually for $9.99. A lifetime subscription is a one-time payment of $24.99 that does not renew and will upgrade your status to Pro for the lifetime of your account. Prices may vary by location. Any portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
Subscriptions are charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Manage your subscription in Account Settings after purchase. Monthly and Yearly subscriptions must be canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period to prevent an auto-renewal. Once purchased, refunds will not be given for any unused portion of the term.
Terms of Service: http://www.datchat.net/terms
Privacy Policy: http://www.datchat.net/privacy

bluejetty:00187970:ios.description:
YENİLENEN BONUSFLAŞ; FIRSATLARLA DOLU AKILLI CÜZDANINIZ!
BonusFlaş, dijital cüzdan, mobil temassız ödeme ve kampanyaları tek uygulamada sunan akıllı finans uygulamasıdır. QR ile ödeme ve GarantiPay ile fiziksel karta ihtiyaç olmadan güvenli ve hızlı ödeme yapın. Kredi kartı yönetimi ve size özel kampanyalarla harcamalarınızı daha faydalı hale getirin.
ANA SAYFA
• Yenilenen BonusFlaş ana sayfası ile işlemlerinizi kolayca yönetebilirsiniz. Kartlarınızı görüntüleyip, mobil temassız ödemelerinizi yapabilir ve kampanyalara tek dokunuşla katılabilirsiniz.
• Size özel mesajları iletişim alanından görüntüleyebilirsiniz.
• Tüm kartlarınızı kolayca görüntüleyebilir ve ödemelerinizi yapabilirsiniz.
• Sık kullandığınız işlemlere ana sayfadan kolayca ulaşabilir, istediğinizde düzenleyebilirsiniz.
• Ana sayfadan tek tıkla kampanyalara katılabilir, sevdiğiniz markaları tek dokunuşla takip edip, fırsatlardan anında haberdar olabilirsiniz.
• Profilim menüsünde bilgilerinizi, güvenlik ve ürün tercih ayarlarınızı yönetebilir; başvuru yapabilir ve takip edebilirsiniz. İhtiyaç anında güvenlik ayarlarınızı değiştirebilirsiniz.
TEMASSIZ DİJİTAL ÖDEMELER
Cüzdan taşımayın, BonusFlaş ile ödeyin!
• Ana sayfada yer alan “ QR ile Öde” ikonuna tıklayarak ya da Ödemeler menüsünden “QR Ödemeleri” adımını seçerek POS üzerinde çıkan QR’ı okutarak hızlı ve kolay bir şekilde ödemenizi gerçekleştirebilirsiniz.
• QR ödemelerinizde birikmiş bonuslarınızı kullanabilir, uygun kartlarınız ile taksitli işlem yapabilirsiniz.
KAMPANYALAR
• Kampanyalar menüsünde her ay 500’den fazla kampanyayı keşfedebilirsiniz.
• Üstelik kampanyalara katılmak artık tek tıkla!
• Her kampanyanın detay sayfasında geçerli koşulları inceleyebilir, katıldığınız kampanyaların durumunu anlık olarak takip edebilirsiniz.
• Gelişmiş arama özelliği sayesinde kampanyaları marka, ürün veya kategoriye göre arayabilir; akıllı filtrelerle aradığınız kampanyaya saniyeler içinde hızlıca ulaşabilirsiniz.
• Katıldığınız kampanyalarda kaçıncı işleminizi yaptığınızı, ne kadar ödül kazandığınızı kolayca görüntüleyebilirsiniz.
ÖDEMELER
• E-ticaret alışverişlerinizde GarantiPay ile 3.000’den fazla işyerinde kart bilginizi vermeden BonusFlaş’tan parolanız ile güvenli ve hızlı bir şekilde işleminizi tamamlayabilirsiniz. 
• Motorlu Taşıt Vergisi (MTV) dahil birçok ödemenizi BonusFlaş üzerinden kolayca gerçekleştirebilirsiniz.
Artık ödeme yapacağınız iş yerinde hangi kart daha faydalı diye düşünmenize gerek yok! İzin verdiğinizde S.M.A.R.T., sizin için daha faydalı kartınızı seçer ve onunla öder! Miles&Smiles veya American Express kart sahibi ve onay verirseniz; yeni teknoloji S.M.A.R.T. "Seçiminde Mobil, Akıllı, Rahat Teknoloji" ile TR Karekod ve GarantiPay’de hangi kart daha faydalıysa işlem o kartla gerçekleşir.
• 3D Secure Mobil Onay ile e-ticaret ödemelerinizi SMS yerine tek dokunuşla onaylayabilirsiniz.
Farklı banka kartlarınızı ekleyerek GarantiPay ödemeleri, İstanbulkart para yükleme, QR ile ödeme ve fatura ödemelerinizi pratik şekilde gerçekleştirebilirsiniz. 
• Ayrıca Karttan Karta Döviz Transferi ile yurt dışı kartlara 7/24 para transferi yapabilirsiniz.
KARTLAR

bluejetty:00090344:ios.description:
Shop now, pay later, with zero interest and zero fees. Forever.
PayLater is Qatar's first Buy Now, Pay Later app licensed by the Qatar Central Bank. Split purchases into up to 4 instalments with PayLater. For eligible orders, FleXed lets you pay over up to 12 months at selected stores. No interest. No fees. No catch.
100% SHARIA-COMPLIANT
PayLater is fully Sharia-compliant and certified by Bait Al Mashoura. 0% interest and 0% fees are not an introductory offer. They are how the product is built, and they are forever.
SPLIT IN 4
Choose your first payment and spread the balance across the remaining instalments. Get approved in minutes with your Qatari ID and a selfie.
FLEXED: UP TO 12 MONTHLY INSTALMENTS
Bigger purchase? FleXed gives you up to 12 monthly instalments for eligible orders at selected stores. Every eligible account gets 10 FleXed credits, one for each instalment you add beyond the standard 4, and you can run up to 2 FleXed orders at the same time. Your credits come back as you repay. Still zero interest, zero fees, fully Sharia-compliant. FleXed is offered based on eligibility and may not be available to everyone.
Terms and conditions apply. Visit https://paylaterapp.com/ for more information.
*The FleXed feature is currently available to users in beta mode.
YOUR FIRST PAYMENT, YOUR CALL
You decide what you pay up front. Choose a first payment at least equal to each remaining instalment and the balance splits evenly across the instalments you choose. Found something that costs more than your limit? Pay the difference up front and split the rest. Your limit does not have to end the sale.
WHERE YOU CAN USE IT
Shop online and in store at more than 1,600 brands and 3,500 branches across Qatar, including Lulu, Fnac and many more.
EVERYTHING IN ONE APP
Track your available limit in real time
See every order and upcoming due date in one place
Repay early whenever you want, at no cost
Manage your cards securely
Switch between English and Arabic anytime
SAFE, LOCAL, TRANSPARENT
Licensed and regulated by the Qatar Central Bank. PCI DSS-compliant payment security. Every transaction is processed locally in Qatar for faster, safer payments.
Join 500,000+ shoppers across Qatar already paying a smarter way.
Buy now pay later Qatar, BNPL Qatar, split payments, pay in 4, instalments, monthly instalments, interest free shopping, Sharia-compliant finance, online shopping Qatar, Doha.

bluejetty:00025322:ios.description:
"The Musketeers Saga" a new episode of the great magical story of the “Connected Hearts”! Conspirators kidnap Princess Mercedes, the lover of Musketeer Arron, in order to seize the throne. Can you help our heroes save the day? Overcome all the difficulties together with the characters, solving puzzles, riddles and finding hidden objects. Learn how to find a way out even in hopeless situations! 
As both Arron and Mercedes start working to stop the traitors, Cardinal and Count d’Monteo, the full extent of the culprits' scheme is revealed. They bribed the guards, poisoned the prince and started capturing musketeers loyal to the prince – all to prevent Gweneale’s coronation. The odds may be against brave lovers, but they have what it takes… right? 
· BONUS CHAPTER!
Play another exciting adventure quest after you finish the main story! Save the crowned King Gweneil in a bonus chapter after a formidable new adversary has replaced him with a double!
· PLAY AS TWO CHARACTERS!
You have the opportunity to explore the heroes' characters and unique personalities by playing as each of them in turn! A loving pair of actors will not leave you indifferent to this adventure!
· EXCLUSIVE COLLECTIONS!
This enchanting love story is filled with collectibles, which you can get during the game! So hurry to play, to fully immerse yourself in the magical atmosphere!
· UNRAVEL ALL THE MYSTERIES! 
A huge number of hidden objects and brain teasers are waiting for you to play! You will be thrilled with a surprising amount of completely different puzzle quests!
This game has a free trial part. You can unlock the full version through an in-app purchase.
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames

UTSWMyCare 
UTSWMyCare, our new streamlined, one-app solution delivers an exceptional experience that UT Southwestern is known for. UTSWMyCare helps patients easily manage their health and stay connected with their provider all with a sens
bluejetty:00149341:ios.description:
UTSWMyCare 
UTSWMyCare, our new streamlined, one-app solution delivers an exceptional experience that UT Southwestern is known for. UTSWMyCare helps patients easily manage their health and stay connected with their provider all with a sense of security throughout their health care journey. The UTSWMyCare app provides access to medical records, lab results, messaging, prescription refills, scheduling, video visits, and wayfinding. A few features are true differentiators from other health system apps. When completing a video visit, just log into the UTSWMyCare app and have everything from the check-in, visit with your provider, and follow-up scheduling all in one place. When a visit to our main campus is essential, UTSWMyCare has a navigation feature that will give turn by turn visual and audio directions from the parking garage to the front desk at your doctor’s office. For those who prefer a ride sharing service, our patients can access Uber and Lyft from within UTSWMyCare and request a ride to any of our locations. In short, UTSWMyCare will offer a simple and convenient digital experience for our patients. 
You must have a MyChart account to access MyChart features in this app. Upload health and fitness data, including data from the Apple Health app, when enrolled in self-tracking programs.

bluejetty:00089134:ios.name: Floraya: Emotional Support
bluejetty:00089134:ios.summary:
Floraya aims to help people move through life’s difficult moments faster and easier. You’ll receive tenderness, human warmth, advice, and moral support every day.
To achieve this, a team of experienced psychotherapists created the Floraya
bluejetty:00089134:ios.description:
Floraya aims to help people move through life’s difficult moments faster and easier. You’ll receive tenderness, human warmth, advice, and moral support every day.
To achieve this, a team of experienced psychotherapists created the Floraya app's core program. This program combines approaches from cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), existential therapy, acceptance and commitment therapy, and client-centered therapy, all blended with gentle and empathetic acceptance. The app's voice acts as a unique blend of friend, muse, therapist, and loyal admirer, offering the most significant words everyone wishes to hear about themselves. It is a source of recognition for one's abilities, qualities, tenderness, and care, serving as a key to good mood and emotional well-being.
FLORAYA FEATURES
* Emotional support – the therapy provides warm, understanding, and supportive interactions.
* Acceptance and unconditional recognition – the therapy focuses on accepting the client as they are, free of judgment.
* Warmth and care – a sense of safety and comfort is created during the interaction.
* Help in tough moments – the therapy helps clients cope with life's current challenges without pressure or intense changes.
* Psychological guidance – ongoing support on the path to personal growth and overcoming stress.
* Enhancing mental well-being – the therapy aims to improve well-being and maintain a stable mental state.
* Support in decision-making – helping clients find their own solutions and understand their needs.
* Reducing anxiety and stress – gentle techniques and support help lower anxiety levels.
* Empathy, tenderness, and warmth – the emphasis is on a caring, understanding approach.
Floraya also takes care of your health by offering guided meditation programs designed to tackle current issues. These meditations help you cope with stress, fear, anxiety, loneliness, increase your self-confidence, and much more.
For relaxation, Floraya transports you to a personal virtual world with customizable soundscapes. Explore hundreds of natural and imagined places to find calm, relax before bed, focus, or enjoy the peace of nature.
Mental Health Supportive Therapy creates a space where listeners feel accepted and supported, which contributes to strengthening their mental health and improving their quality of life.
Disclaimer: This app is not a substitute for professional mental health care. Always consult a licensed mental health professional.
Try the MAX Subscription and enjoy unlimited access to Floraya:
– Payments are charged to your Apple ID once your purchase is confirmed.
– The subscription automatically renews unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
– You can manage and cancel subscriptions in their account settings on the App Store.
More about our terms and conditions:
https://euforia.digital/info/terms
https://euforia.digital/info/privacy

bluejetty:00078193:ios.name: Color My Life
bluejetty:00078193:ios.summary: Color My Life® is a cataloging app designed exclusively for paper crafters. Quickly and easily organize and catalog your paper crafting supplies. Spend more time designing and creating, and less time searching through disorganized inventory
bluejetty:00078193:ios.description:
Color My Life® is a cataloging app designed exclusively for paper crafters. Quickly and easily organize and catalog your paper crafting supplies. Spend more time designing and creating, and less time searching through disorganized inventory. Stop buying the same item twice (or more)! Add items to your wishlist for future purchases. Add a storage location so you know exactly where to find your supplies when you need them. We’re here to help you get organized!
Color My Life has an intuitive user-centric design and features these capabilities:
• Barcode Catalog: Quickly add an item by scanning a barcode or searching the barcode catalog. Color My Life automatically populates the item’s image and attributes. We are continually adding to the barcode catalog with new manufacturers and product releases.
• Duplicate warning: Adding an item with a duplicate barcode will generate a warning.
• Smart Color Tagging: Automatically create color tags based on the item’s image.
• Storage Location: Add a storage location, so you know exactly where to find your supplies when you need them.
• Searching and Filtering: Find your items by searching for both word and color tags. Use the filtering tool to select a Manufacturer or Category.
• Create sets: Items that are used together, like a collection or coordinating stamps and dies, can be combined into sets, so they are easy to find even if they are stored separately.
• Project Organization: Much like a recipe, Color My Life brings supplies and inspiration together as projects.
There is a 30-day free trial so you can get to know the app before deciding to subscribe. After the trial, you have access to all your content, but you need a subscription to continue adding new items. We offer monthly ($1.99 USD) and yearly ($19.99 USD) subscriptions. 
By subscribing, you will have access to new additions in our barcode catalog, syncing your content to multiple devices, online backups, as well as frequent app updates with new functionality. Try Color My Life today!
The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscription and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase.
Terms: https://colormylife.com/terms-and-conditions
Privacy Policy: https://colormylife.com/privacy/
